Mishneh Torah, Blessings 3: Chamishsha minin hen. hachittin vehasseorin vehakkussemin veshibbolet shual veshippon. hakkussemin mimmin hachittin veshibbolet shual veshippon mimmin hasseorim. vachamishsha minin haellu keshehen shibbolim nikraim tevua bechol makom. veachar sheddashin vezorin otan nikrain dagan. ucheshettochanin otan velashin et kimchan veofin otan nikrain pat. vehappat hannaase meechad mehen hi hannikret pat bechol makom belo liuuy:

Haochel pat chayyav levarech lefaneha baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hammotzi lechem min haaretz. uleachareha arba berachot. achal dagan shaluk kemo shehu mevarech lefanav bore peri haadama. uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot. achal kemach mevarech lefanav shehakkol uleacharav bore nefashot rabbot:

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin sheshshelakuhu veervu bemayim o bishar mashkim im haya ave kede sheyyihye rauy laachila ulelooso mevarech alav battechilla bore mine mezonot ulevassof al hammichya veal hakkalkala. veim haya rach kede sheyyihye rauy lishtiyya mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:

Kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin shebbishshelo bikdera ben levaddo ben sheervo im devarim acherim kegon levivot vechayyotze bahen. vechen haddagan shechilleko o ketasho uvishshelo bikdera kegon harifot vegeres hakkarmel vechayyotze bahen vechol ze hu hannikra maase kedera. vechen kol tavshil sheerev bo mechameshet hamminin ben kemach ben pat. battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot:

Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya hammin hazze chashuv etzlo velo haya tefela. aval im haya echad mechameshet hamminin sheerev tefela eno mevarech ella al haikkar ufoter et hattefela. veze kelal bivrachot kol shehu ikkar veimmo tefela mevarech al haikkar ufoter et hattefela ben shehayta hattefela meorevet im haikkar ben shello hayta meorevet:

Ketzad hi hattefela hameorevet. kegon lefet o keruv shebbishshelo veerev bo kemach shel echad mechameshet hamminin kede ledabbeko eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot shehallefet hu haikkar vekimcho tefela. shekkol davar shemmearvin oto ledabbek o kede litten reach o kede litzboa et hattavshil hare zo tefela. aval im erev kede litten taam battaarovot hare hu ikkar. lefichach mine devash shemmevashshelin otan venotnin bahen chelev chitta kede ledabbek veosin mehen mine metika eno mevarech alav bore mine mezonot mippene shehaddevash hu haikkar:

Ketzad hi hattefela sheenah meorevet. hare shetztzarich leechol dag maliach veachal happat immo kede shello yazzik hammelach gerono uleshono hare ze mevarech al hammaliach ufoter et happat mippene shehappat tefela lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Happat sheppatat otah pittim uvishlah bikdera o lashah bemarak. im yesh bappetitin kezayit o shenikkar shehen pat velo nishtanna tzuratah mevarech aleha battechilla hammotzi. veim en bahen kezayit o sheubbera tzurat happat babbishshul mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot:

Issa shenneefet bakkarka kemo shehaarviyyim shochne hammidbarot ofim hoil veen aleha tzurat pat mevarech aleha battechilla bore mine mezonot. veim kava mezono aleha mevarech hammotzi. vechen issa shellashah bidvash o beshemen o bechalav o sheerev bah mine tavlin vaafaah vehi hannikret pat habbaa bechisnin af al pi shehu pat mevarech aleha bore mine mezonot. veim kava seuddato aleha mevarech hammotzi:

Orez shebbishshelo o sheasa mimmennu pat battechilla mevarech alav bore mine mezonot ulevassof bore nefashot. uvilvad shello yehe meorav im davar acher ella orez levaddo. aval pat dochan o pat shel shear mine kitnit battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot:

Kol shemmevarchin alav battechilla hammotzi mevarchin leacharav bassof birkat hammazon kesidrah arba berachot. vechol shemmevarchin alav battechilla bore mine mezonot mevarchin bassof leacharav beracha achat meen shalosh chutz min haorez:

Bamme devarim amurim sheachal mikkezayit ulemala aval achal pachot mikkezayit ben min happat ben mishshear ochlin. vehashshote pachot merviit ben min hayyayin ben mishshear mashkin. mevarech battechilla beracha haruya leoto hammin ulevassof eno mevarech kelal:

Vezo hi beracha achat meen shalosh. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal eretz chemda tova urechava sheratzita veshehinchalta et avotenu rachem Adonai elohenu alenu veal yisrael ammecha veal yerushalayim irecha veal tziyyon mishkan kevodecha vehaalenu letochah vesammechenu bevinyanah unevarechcha aleha bikdushsha uvetohora baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya. uveshabbatot veyamim tovim omer bivracha zo bichlalah meen kedushshat hayyom kederech shemmazkir bevirkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 4: Kol hamevarech birkat hammazon o beracha achat meen shalosh tzarich levarech otah bammakom sheachal. achal keshehu mehallech yoshev bemakom sheppasak vivarech. achal keshehu omed yoshev bimkomo vivarech. shachach levarech birkat hammazon venizkar kodem sheyyitakkel hammazon shebbemeav mevarech bammakom shennizkar. veim haya mezid chozer limkomo umevarech. veim berech bammakom shennizkar yatza yede chovato. vechen im berech keshehu omed o keshehu mehallech yatza yede chovato. ulechattechilla lo yevarech birkat hammazon velo beracha shemmeen shalosh ella keshehu yoshev uvammakom sheachal:

Mi shennistappek lo im berech hammotzi o lo berech hammotzi eno chozer umevarech mippene sheeno min hattora. shachach levarech hammotzi. im nizkar ad shello gamar seuddato chozer umevarech veim nizkar leachar sheggamar eno chozer umevarech:

Haya ochel bevayit ze ufasak seuddato vehalach levayit acher. o shehaya ochel ukeraahu chavero ledabber immo veyatza lo lefetach beto vechazar hoil veshinna mekomo tzarich levarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech battechilla hammotzi veachar kach yigmor seuddato:

Chaverim shehayu yoshvim leechol veyatzu likrat chatan o likrat kalla. im hinnichu sham zaken o chole chozrin limkoman vegomrin seuddatan veenan tzerichin levarech sheniyya. veim lo hinnichu sham adam keshehen yotzin tzerichin beracha lemafrea ucheshehen chozrin tzerichin beracha lechattechilla:

Vechen im hayu mesubbin bishtiyya o leechol perot. shekkol hameshanne mekomo hare pasak achilato ulefichach mevarech lemafrea al ma sheachal vechozer umevarech sheniyya lechattechilla al ma shehu tzarich leechol. vehameshanne mekomo mippinna lefinna bevayit echad eno tzarich lachazor ulevarech. achal bemizrachah shel teena uva leechol bemaaravah tzarich lachazor ulevarech:

Berech al happat patar et happarperet sheochlin bahen happat mimmine hattavshil uferot vechayyotze bahen. aval im berech al happarperet lo patar et happat. berech al maase kedera patar et hattavshil berech al hattavshil lo patar et maase kedera:

Gamar belibbo milleechol o millishtot veachar kach nimlach leechol o lishtot af al pi shello shinna mekomo chozer umevarech. veim lo gamar belibbo ella dato lachazor leechol velishtot afillu pasak kol hayyom kullo eno tzarich levarech shenit:

Hayu shotin veamru bou unevarech birkat hammazon o bou unekaddesh kiddush hayyom neesar alehem lishtot ad sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu. veim ratzu lachazor velishtot kodem sheyyevarchu o yekaddeshu af al pi sheenam rashshaim tzerichim lachazor ulevarech techilla bore peri haggafen veachar kach yishtu. aval im amru bou venavdil en tzerichin lachazor ulevarech:

Hayu mesubbin lishtot yayin uva lahen min yayin acher kegon shehayu shotin adom veheviu shachor o yashan veheviu chadash enan tzerichin levarech birkat hayyayin paam sheniyya. aval mevarchin baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv:

En mevarchin al ochel min kol hoochalin velo al mashke min kol hammashkin ad sheyyavo lefanav. veim berech veachar kach hevio lefanav tzarich lachazor ulevarech. natal ochel uverech alav venafal miyyado venisraf o shetafo nahar notel acher vechozer umevarech alav af al pi shehu meoto hammin. vetzarich lomar baruch shem kevod malchuto leolam vaed al beracha rishona kede shello lehotzi shem shamayim levattala. omed adam al ammat hammayim umevarech veshote af al pi shehammayim shehayu lefanav bishat habberacha enam hammayim sheshshata mippene shellechach nitkavven techilla:

Devarim habbaim betoch hasseudda vehen mechamat hasseudda enan tzerichin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem ella birkat hammotzi shebbattechilla uvirkat hammazon shebbassof poteret hakkol shehakkol tefela lasseudda. udevarim sheenan mechamat hasseudda shebbau betoch hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehem velo leacharehem. udevarim habbaim leachar hasseudda ben mechamat hasseudda ben shello mechamat hasseudda teunin beracha lifnehen uleacharehem:

Beshabbatot uveyamim tovim uvisudat hakkazat haddam uveshaa sheyyatza min hammerchatz vechayyotze bahen sheadam kovea seuddato al hayyayin. im berech al hayyayin shellifne hammazon patar et hayyayin sheshshata leachar hammazon kodem sheyyevarech birkat hammazon. aval bishar hayyamim tzarich lachazor ulevarech battechilla al hayyayin shel achar hammazon. ba lahen yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo sheen bet habbelia panuy sheyyaanu amen veeno poter et hayyayin shelleachar hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 5: Nashim vaavadim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon. vesafek yesh baddavar im hen chayyavin min hattora lefi sheen kavua lah zeman o enam chayyavin min hattora. lefichach en motziin et haggedolim yede chovatan. aval hakketannim chayyavin bevirkat hammazon middivre sofrim kede lechannechan bemitzvot:

Shelosha sheachlu pat keechad chayyavin levarech birkat hazzimmun kodem birkat hammazon. vee zo hi birkat hazzimmun. im hayu haochlim mishshelosha ad asara mevarech echad mehem veomer nevarech sheachalnu mishshello vehakkol onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer umevarech baruch sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu:
Veachar kach omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hazzan et haolam kullo betuvo ad sheggomer arba berachot. vehen onin amen achar kol beracha uveracha:

Hayu haochlin measara ulemala mezammenin beshem. ketzad. hamevarech omer nevarech lelohenu sheachalnu mishshello. vehen onin baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. vehu chozer veomer baruch elohenu sheachalnu mishshello uvetuvo chayinu. umatchil birkat hammazon:

Hassoed bevet chatanim mishsheyyatchilu lehitassek betzarche seuddat nissuin velahachinah ad sheloshim yom achar hannissuin mevarech nevarech shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onim baruch shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello vechulei. veim hayu asara mevarech nevarech lelohenu shehassimcha bimono sheachalnu mishshello. vehem onin baruch elohenu shehassimcha vechulei. vechen seudda sheosin otah achar hannissuin mechamat hannissuin ad shenem asar chodesh mevarech shehassimcha bimono:

Hakkol chayyavin bevirkat hazzimmun kederech shechayyavin bevirkat hammazon. afillu kohanim sheachlu kadshe hakkadashim baazara. vechen kohanim veyisreelim sheachlu keechad veachlu hakkohanim teruma veyisrael chullin chayyavin bezimmun kechiyyuvan bevirkat hammazon:

Nashim vaavadim uketannim en mezammenin alehen aval mezammenin leatzman. velo tehe chavura shel nashim vaavadim uketannim mippene happeritzut. aval nashim mezammenot leatzman o avadim leatzman uvilvad shello yezammenu beshem. anderoginus mezammen lemino veeno mezammen lo lenashim velo laanashim mippene shehu safek. vehattumtum eno mezammen kelal. katan hayyodea lemi mevarchin mezammenin alav veaf al pi shehu keven sheva o keven shemone. umitztaref ben leminyan shelosha ben leminyan asara lezammen alav. vehannachri en mezammenin alav:

En mezammenin ella al mi sheachal kezayit pat ulemala. shiva sheachlu pat ushelosha achlu immahen yarak o tzir vechayyotze bahen mitztarfin lezammen beshem. vehu sheyyihye hamevarech meochle happat. aval shishsha sheachlu pat vearbaa yarak en mitztarfin ad sheyyihyu ochle happat rov hannikkar. bamme devarim amurim baasara. aval bishlosha tzarich sheyyochlu kol echad veechad mehen kezayit pat veachar kach mezammenin:

Shenayim sheachlu vegamru milleechol uva shelishi veachal. im yecholin leechol immo kol shehu vaafillu mishshear ochalin mitztaref immahen. vechacham gadol shebbamsubbin hu shemmevarech lechullan af al pi shello ba ella baacharona:

Shelosha sheachlu keechad enan rashshain lechalek. vechen arbaa vechen chamishsha. veshishsha yesh lahem lechalek ad asara. measara ulemala enam rashshaim lechalek ad esrim. shekkol zeman sheyyechalku vetihye birkat hazzimmun lechol chelek vechelek kezimmun hakkol yesh lahem lechalek:

Shelosha bene adam shebbau mishshalosh chavurot shel shelosha shelosha enan rashshain lechalek. veim kevar zimmen kol echad veechad mehen bachavura shello rashshain lechalek. veenan chayyavin bezimmun shekkevar zimmenu alehen. shelosha sheyyashvu leechol pat af al pi shekkol echad veechad ochel mishshello enan rashshain lechalek:

Shete chavurot shehayu ochlin bevayit echad. bizman shemmiktzatan roin ellu et ellu mitztarfin lezimmun echad. veim lav ellu mezammenin leatzman veellu mezammenin leatzman. veim yesh shammash echad benehem shehu holech umeshammesh mechavura zo lachavura zo mitztarfin lezimmun echad af al pi sheen miktzat ellu roin et ellu. vehu sheyyishmeu shetehen kol divre hamevarech beveur:

Shelosha sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk korin lo kede sheyyechavven lishmoa ma shehen omrim umezammenin alav vehu bashshuk veyotze yede chovato. velichsheyyachazor leveto yachazor vivarech birkat hammazon leatzmo aval asara sheachlu veyatza echad mehen lashshuk en mezammenin alav ad sheyyachazor limkomo veyeshev immahen:
Shelosha sheachlu keechad vekadam echad mehen uverech leatzmo mezammenin alav veyatzu hashshenayim yede chovat zimmun vehu lo yatza bezimmun ze sheen zimmun lemafrea:

Shenayim sheachlu keechad kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. veim haya echad mehen yodea veechad eno yodea ze sheyyodea mevarech bekol ram vehashsheni one amen achar kol beracha uveracha veyotze yede chovato. uven mevarech leaviv. veeved mevarech lerabbo. veishsha mevarechet levalah. veyotzin yede chovatan. aval amru chachamim tavo meera lemi sheishto uvanav mevarchin lo:

Bamme devarim amurim sheyyatzu yede chovatan bizman sheachlu velo savu shehen chayyavim levarech middivre sofrim ulefichach motziin otan katan o eved o ishsha mide chovatan. aval im achal vesava shehu chayyav bevirkat hammazon min hattora. ben ishsha ben katan o eved en motziin otan. shekkol hachayyav bedavar min hattora en motziin otan mide chovatan ella hachayyav beoto davar min hattora kemoto:

Hannichnas etzel acherim umetzaan mevarchin bevirkat hazzimmun. im matza hamevarech omer nevarech hu one baruch hu umevorach. veim matza haochlim onin baruch sheachalnu mishshello hu one acharehen amen:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 6: Kol haochel happat shemmevarchin alav hammotzi tzarich netilat yadayim techilla vasof. veaf al pi shehi pat chullin veaf al pi sheen yadav meluchlachot veeno yodea lahen tuma lo yochal ad sheyyittol shete yadav. vechen kol davar shettibbulo bemashkin tzarich netilat yadayim techilla:

Kol hannotel yadav ben laachila ben likriat shema ben litfilla mevarech techilla asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al netilat yadayim. shezzo mitzvat chachamim shennitztavvenu min hattora lishmoa mehen shenneemar <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "al pi hattora asher yorucha". vmayim acharonim en mevarchin alehen sheenam ella mippene hassakkana. ulefichach chayyav adam lehizzaher bahen beyoter:

Netilat yadayim ben tavshil letavshil reshut. ratza notel ratza eno notel. uferot shel chullin enan tzerichin netilat yadayim ben battechilla ben bassof. vechol hannotel yadav leferot hare ze miggasse haruach. kol pat shehammelach bo tzarich netilat yadayim baacharona shemma yesh bo melach sedomit o melach shettivo kemelach sedomit veyaavir yadav al enav visamme. mippene ze chayyavin littol yadayim besof kol seudda mippene hammelach. uvemachane peturim minnetilat yadayim battechilla mippene shehen terudim bemilchama. vechayyavin baacharona mippene hassakkana:
Ad hechan hi netilat yadayim. ad happerek. vechamma shiur hammayim. reviit lechol shete yadayim. vechol shechotztzim bitvila chotzetz bintilat yadayim. vechol haole lemiddat mikve ole leshiur reviit:

Kol hatztzarich netilat yadayim vehitbil yadav beme mikve eno tzarich davar acher. veim hitbilan bemayim sheen bahem shiur mikve o bemayim sheuvin shebbakkarka lo asa kelum sheen hammayim sheuvin metaharin et hayyadayim ella bintila:

Kol hannotel yadav tzarich lehizzaher bearbaa devarim. bammayim atzman shello yihyu pesulin lintilat yadayim. uvashshiur sheyyihye bahen reviit lechol shete yadayim. uvakkeli sheyyihyu hammayim shennotlin bahen bichli. uvenotel sheyyihyu hammayim bain mikkoach noten:

Arbaa devarim poslin et hammayim. shinnuy mare. vegilluy. vaasiyyat melacha bahen. vehefsed shemmonea et habbehema millishtot mehen. ketzad. mayim shennishtannu maritan ben bechelim ben bekarkaot ben mechamat davar shennafal letochan ben mechamat mekoman hare ellu pesulin. vechen im nitgallu gilluy haoser otan mishshetiyya nifselu lintilat yadayim:

Kol mayim shennaasa bahen melacha naasu shofchin ufesulin lintilat yadayim. ketzad. mayim sheuvin shehediach bahen kelim o sheshshara bahem pitto vechayyotze beze ben bechelim ben bekarkaot pesulin lintilat yadayim. hediach bahen kelim mudachin o chadashim lo pesalan. mayim shehannachtom metabbel bahen et hakkeachim pesulin. veshehu chofen mehen bishat lisha kesherim. shehammayim shebbechafnav hen shennaasu bahen melacha. aval hammayim shechofen mehem hare hen bechashrutan:

Vechol mayim shennifselu mishshetiyyat kelev. kegon shehayu marim o meluchim o achurin o reach ra ad shello yishte mehen hakkelev. bechelim pesulin lintilat yadayim uvekarkaot kesherim lehatebil. chamme teverya bimkoman matbilin bahem et hayyadayim. aval im natal mehen bichli o shehiflig mehen amma lemakom acher en notlin mehen lo rishonim velo acharonim mippene sheenan reuyin lishtiyyat behema:

Yesh lannotel litten al yadav meat meat ad sheyyitten kashshiur. veim natan harviit kullah bishtifa achat kasher. notlin arbaa o chamishsha ze betzad ze o yad ze al gabbe ze bishtifa achat. uvilvad sheyyarpu yedehen kede sheyyavo benehen hammayim. veyihye beotah hashshetifa kede reviit lechol echad veechad:

En notlin mayim layyadayim lo bedafnot hakkelim velo beshule hammachatz velo bacharasim velo bimgufat hechavit. veim tikken hammegufa lintila notlin mimmenna layyadayim. vechen hachemet shettikkenah notlin mimmenna layyadayim. aval sak vekuppa shennitkenu en notlin mehen layyadayim. velo yitten lachavero bechafnav sheen chafnav keli. vechelim shennishberu shevira hametaheret otan mide tuma en notnin bahem layyadayim mippene shehen shivre kelim:
Bechol hakkelim notlim layyadayim vaafillu kele gelalim uchele adama. vehu sheyyihyu shelemim. keli sheeno machazik reviit o en bo reviit en notnin mimmenna layyadayim:

Hakkol kesherin litten layyadayim afillu cheresh shote vekatan. im en sham acher manniach hakkeli ben birkav vetzak al yadav. o yatte hechavit al yadav veyittol. o notel yado achat vetzak bezo al zo vechozer vetzak barishona al hashsheniyya. vehakkof notel layyadayim:

Hashshoket sheddole adam beyado o begalgal venoten letochah vehammayim nimshachin mimmenna baamma veholchin umashkin hayerakot o habbehema vehinniach yadav bashshoket veavru hammayim veshatfu al yadav lo alta lo netila. shehare en kan noten al yadav. veim hayu yadav kerovot lishfichat haddeli ad shennimtzeu hammayim shatfu al yadav mikkoach netinat haadam alta lo netila:

Mayim shennistappek lo im naasa mehen melacha o lo naasa. im yesh bahen kashshiur o sheen bahen. im hen tehorin o temein. safek natal yadav safek lo natal yadav. sefeko tahor shekkol safek shebbetohorat yadayim tahor:

Mayim harishonim tzarich sheyyagbiah yadav lemala ad shello yetzu mayim chutz lapperek veyachzeru vitammeu et hayyadayim. veacharonim tzarich sheyyashpil yadav lematta kede sheyyetze kol koach hammelach meal yadav. mayim rishonim nittalim ben al gabbe keli ben al gabbe karka. veacharonim enan nittalin ella al gabbe keli. mayim rishonim nittalin ben bechamme haur ben betzonen. veacharonim enan nittalin bechammin. vehu sheyyihyu chammim shehayyad soledet bahen mippene sheen maavirin et hazzuhama, sheeno yachol leshafshef bahen. aval hayu poshrin notlin mehen baacharona:

Notel adam yadav shacharit umatne alehen kol hayyom veeno tzarich littol et yadav lechol achila vaachila. vehu shello yassiach dato mehen. aval im hissiach dato mehen tzarich littol yadav bechol et shetztzarich netila:

Lat adam et yadav bemappa veochel bahen pat o davar shettibbulo bemashke af al pi shello natal yadav. hammaachil laacherim eno tzarich netilat yadayim. vehaochel tzarich netilat yadayim af al pi sheacher noten letoch piv veeno nogea bammaachol. vehu haddin leochel bemagrefa shetztzarich netilat yadayim:

Asur lehaachil mi shello natal yadav veaf al pi shehu noten letoch piv. veasur lezalzel bintilat yadayim. vetziuuyim harebe tziuu chachamim vehizhiru al haddavar. afillu en lo mayim ella kede shetiyya notel yadav bemiktzatan veachar kach ochel veshote miktzatan:

Tzarich adam lenaggev et yadav veachar kach yochal. vechol haochel belo nigguv yadayim keochel lechem tame. vechol hannotel yadav baacharona menaggev veachar kach mevarech. vetechef lintilat yadayim birkat hammazon, lo yafsik benehem bedavar acher. afillu lishtot mayim achar shennotel yadav baacharona asur ad sheyyevarech birkat hammazon:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 7: Minhagot rabbot nahagu chachme yisrael basseudda vechullan derech eretz. veellu hen. keshennichnasin lasseudda haggadol shebbechullan notel et yadav techilla. veachar kach nichnasin veyoshvin mesubbin. vegadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lematta hemennu. hayu shelosha mittot gadol mesev barosh vesheni lo lemala hemennu ushelishi lo lematta hemennu:

Baal habbayit mevarech hammotzi umashlim habberacha veachar kach botzea. vehaoreach mevarech birkat hammazon kede sheyyevarech levaal habbayit. veim hayu kullan baale habbayit haggadol shebbahen botzea vehu mevarech birkat hammazon:

En habbotzea rashshay livtzoa ad sheyyaviu melach o liftan lifne kol echad veechad ella im ken nitkavvenu leechol pat chareva. veeno botzea lo perusa ketanna mippene shehu nire ketzar ayin velo perusa gedola yoter mikkevetza mippene shennire kiravtan. uveshabbat yesh lo livtzoa perusa gedola. veeno botzea ella mimmakom shennitbashshel yafe yafe:

Mitzva min hammuvchar livtzoa kikkar shelema. im hayta sham shelema shel seorim uferusa shel chittim manniach shelema betoch perusa uvotzea mishshetehen kede sheyyivtza mechittim umishshelema. beshabbatot uveyamim tovim chayyav livtzoa al shete kikkarot notel shetehen beyado uvotzea achat mehen:

Habbotzea noten perusa lifne kol echad veechad. vehaacher notel beyado. veen habbotzea noten beyad haochel ella im ken haya avel. vehabbotzea hu poshet yadav techilla veochel. veen hammesubbin rashshain litom ad sheyyitom hamevarech. veen habbotzea rashshay litom ad sheyyichle amen mippi rov hammesubbin. veim ratza habbotzea lachalok kavod lerabbo o lemi shehu gadol mimmennu bechachma veyannichennu lifshot yado kodem lo harshut beyado:

Shenayim mamtinin ze laze bikara. shelosha en mamtinin. gamru mehen shenayim hashshelishi mafsik immahen. gamar echad mehen hashshenayim en mafsikin lo ella ochlin veholchin ad sheggomrin. en mesichin bisudda kede shello yavo lide sakkana. umippene ze im ba lahem yayin betoch hammazon kol echad veechad mevarech leatzmo. sheim berech echad veone haone amen bishat habbelia yavo lide sakkana. veen mistakkelin bifne haochel velo limnato shello levayyesho:

Hashshammash sheomed lifne hammesubbin eno ochel immahen. vederech rachamanut hu litten letoch piv mikkol tavshil vetavshil kede leyashshev dato. veim natnu lo yayin mevarech al kol kos vechos shennotnin lo. mippene sheen shetiyyato teluya birtzono ella birtzonam:

Yatza echad min hammesubbin lehashetin mayim notel yado achat venichnas. dibber im chavero vehiflig notel shete yadav venichnas. im hayu mesubbin lishtiyya nichnas veyoshev bimkomo venotel yadav veachar kach machazir panav laorchin. velamma notel bimkomo shemma yomru lo natal yadav mippene sheen sham achila:

En mannichin basar chay al happat. veen maavirin kos male al happat. veen somchin et hakkeara befat. veen zorkin et happat. velo et hachatichot velo et hoochalin sheen lahen kelippin kegon tutim vaanavim uteenim mippene shehen nimasin. umuttar limshoch et hayyayin betzinnorot bevatte chatanim vezorkin lifnehem kelayot veegozim bimot hachamma aval lo bimot haggeshamim mippene shennimasin. veen notlin yedehen beyayin ben chay ben mazug. vechen en mafsidin shear ochalin umashkin derech bizzuy uveita:

Asur leorchim littol kelum mimma shellifnehem velitten beyad beno o bitto shel baal habbayit shemma yitbayyesh baal hasseudda shehare en lo ella ma shehevi lifnehem venimtzeu hakketannim notlim otam veholchim. lo yishlach adam lachavero chavit yayin veshemen tzaf al piha shemma yishlach lo adam chavit shekkullah yayin vidamme shehu shemen veshemen hu sheal paneha bilvad vizammen orchim veyitbayyesh. vechen kol kayyotze bidvarim ellu hammeviim lide busha levaal hasseudda asurin:

Gamru milleechol mesallekin et hashshulchan umechabbedin et hammakom sheachlu bo veachar kach notlin et yedehem. shemma yeshayyeru sham perurin sheyyesh bahen kezayit sheasur lehallech bahen velirchotz alehen. aval perurin sheen bahen kezayit muttar leabbedan bayyad:

Heviu lahem mayim lintila kol shemmevarech birkat hammazon hu notel yadav techilla. kede shello yeshev haggadol veyadav mezohamot ad sheyyittol acher. ushear hassoadin notlin yadan bassof ze achar ze. veen mechabbedin bedavar ze sheen mechabbedin beyadayim mezohamot velo bigsharim velo bidrachim ella befetach harauy limzuza uvishat kenisa:
Gamru littol yedehen veniggevu yedehen uverchu birkat hammazon veheviu et hammugmar. mi shebberech birkat hammazon hu mevarech al hammugmar vechullan onin amen:

Im haya sham yayin meviin kos machazik reviit o yater al reviit. umeviin besamim veochez et hayyayin bimino veet habbesamim bismolo umevarech birkat hammazon. veachar kach mevarech al hayyayin. veachar kach mevarech al habbesamim. im hayu habbesamim shemen arev vechayyotze bo tacho berosh hashshammash. veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel kede shello yetze mevussam lashshuk:

Af al pi sheen birkat hammazon tzericha yayin. im berech al hayyayin kamminhag sheamarnu tzarich sheyyadiach kos shel beracha mibbifnim velishtof oto mibbachutz. vimalleennu yayin chay. vechevan shehiggia levirkat haaretz noten letocho meat mayim kede sheyyehe arev lishtiyya. veen mesichin al kos shel birkat hammazon ella hakkol shotkim ad shettichle birkat hammazon uvirkat hayyayin veyishtu:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 8: Kol perot hailan mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haetz ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot chutz mechameshet hamminin hakketuvin battora. vehem anavim verimmonim uteenim vezetim utemarim shehu mevarech alehen bassof beracha achat meen shalosh. veal perot haaretz vehayerakot mevarchin alehen battechilla bore peri haadama ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. devarim sheen giddulan min haaretz kegon basar ugevina vedagim uvetzim umayim vechalav udevash vechayyotze bahen battechilla mevarech shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. vehashshote mayim shello lerauot tzamo eno taun beracha lo lefanav velo leacharav:

Hassochet perot vehotzi mehen mashkin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot. chutz min haanavim vehazzetim. sheal hayyayin hu mevarech bore peri haggafen ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh. veal hashshemen battechilla hu mevarech bore peri haetz. bamme devarim amurim shehaya choshesh bigrono veshata min hashshemen im me hashshelakot vechayyotze bahen shehare nehene bishtiyyato. aval im shata hashshemen levaddo o shello haya choshesh bigrono mevarech alav shehakkol. shehare lo nehena betaam hashshemen:

Perot o yerakot sheddarkan leheachel chayyim im bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot. virakot sheddarkan leheachel shelukin kegon keruv velefet im achalan chayyin mevarech alehen battechilla shehakkol ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. veim bishlan o shelakan mevarech alehen bore peri haadama ulevassof bore nefashot rabbot. devarim sheddarkan leheachel chayyin umevushshalin achalan ben chayyin ben mevushshalin mevarech alehen battechilla beracha haruya lahen. im hayu perot etz mevarech bore peri haetz veim hayu perot haadama o yerakot mevarech bore peri haadama:

Yerakot sheddarkan lehishshalek shelakan mevarech al me shelek shellahen bore peri haadama. vehu sheshshelakan lishtot memehen shemmeme hashshelakot kishlakot bemakom sheddarkan lishtotan. devash temarim mevarchin alav techilla shehakkol. aval temarim shemmeachan bayyad vehotzi garinin shellahen vaasaan kemo issa mevarech alehen techilla bore peri haetz ulevassof beracha achat meen shalosh:

Hakkanim hammetukim shessochatin otan umevashshelin memehen ad sheyyikpa veyidme lemelach. kol haggeonim omrim shemmevarchin alav bore peri haadama. umiktzatam amru bore peri haetz. vechen amru shehammotzetz otam kanim mevarech bore peri haadama. vaani omer sheen ze peri veen mevarchin alav ella shehakkol. shello yihye devash ellu hakkanim shennishtanna al yede ur gadol middevash temarim shello nishtanna al yede haur umevarchin alav shehakkol:

Hakkor vehu rosh haddekel shehu kemo etz lavan mevarech alav battechilla shehakkol. kafras shel tzalaf mevarech alav bore peri haadama mippene sheeno peri. vehaevyonot shel tzalaf hen happeri shehen ketzurot temarim dakkim ketannim mevarech alehen bore peri haetz:

Happilpelin vehazzangevil bizman shehen retubbin mevarech alehen bore peri haadama. aval yeveshin en teunin beracha lo lifnehem velo leacharehem mippene shehen tavlin veeno ochel. vechen ochalin sheen reuyin laachila umashkin sheenan reuyin lishtiyya enan teunin beracha lo lifnehen velo leacharehen:

Happat sheippesha vehayyayin shehikrim vetavshil sheavra tzurato vehannovlot shehen paggin vehashshechar vehachometz vehaggovay vehammelach vehakkemehin vehappitriyyot al kullan mevarech techilla shehakkol. vechol hamevarchin lefanav shehakkol laacharona mevarech bore nefashot. vechol hattaun beracha leacharav taun beracha lefanav:

Shemarim shennatan alehem shelosha vehotzi mehen arbaa mevarech alehen bore peri haggafen shezze yayin mazug hu. hotzi pachot mearbaa af al pi sheyyesh bahem taam yayin mevarech alehen shehakkol techilla:
Berech al perot hailan bore peri haadama yatza. veal perot haadama bore peri haetz lo yatza. veal kullam im berech shehakkol yatza. vaafillu al happat veal hayyayin:

Lakach kos shel shechar beyado vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar shehakkol vetaa veamar bore peri haggafen en machzirin oto. vechen im hayu lefanav perot haaretz vehitchil habberacha al menat lomar bore peri haadama vetaa veamar bore peri haetz en machzirin oto. vechen im haya lefanav tavshil shel dagan ufatach al menat lomar bore mine mezonot vetaa veamar hammotzi yatza. mippene shebbeshaa shehizkir et hashshem vehammalchut shehen ikkar habberacha lo nitkavven ella livracha haruya leoto hammin. vehoil velo haya beikkar habberacha taut af al pi shettaa besofah yatza veen machzirin oto:

Kol habberachot haellu im nistappek lo bahem im berech o lo berech eno chozer umevarech lo battechilla velo bassof. mippene shehen middivre sofrim. shachach vehichnis ochalin letoch piv belo beracha. im hayu mashkin bolan umevarech alehen bassof. veim hayu perot sheim zerakan yimmaasu kegon tutim vaanavim mesallekan letzad echad umevarech veachar kach bolan. veim enan nimasin kegon polim vaafunim poltan mippiv ad sheyyevarech ufiv panuy veachar kach ochel:

Hayu lefanav minin harebe im hayu birchotehen shavot mevarech al achat mehem ufoter et hashshear. veim en birchotehem shavot mevarech al kol achat mehen beracha haruya lo. vee ze mehem sheyyirtze lehakedim makdim. veim eno rotze beze yoter mizze im yesh benehem echad mishshivat hamminim alav hu mevarech techilla. vechol hakkodem bappasuk kodem babberacha. vehashshiva hen haamurim befasuk ze <small>(Devarim 8 8)</small> "eretz chitta useora vegefen uteena verimmon eretz zet shemen udevash". udevash ze hu devash temarim. vehattemarim kodmin laanavim. shehattemarim sheni leeretz vehaanavim shelishi leeretz:

Beracha achat shehi meen shalosh shel chameshet hamminin shel perot veshel yayin hi shel mine haddagan. ella sheal happerot hu omer al haetz veal peri haetz veal tenuvat hassade veal eretz chemda vechulei. veal hayyayin hu omer al haggefen veal peri haggefen. vechotem bishtehen al haaretz veal happerot. veim haya beeretz yisrael chotem al haaretz veal peroteha. veyesh mi shemmosif babberacha shemmeen shalosh kodem chatima ki el tov umetiv atta shehu meen beracha reviit. veyesh mi sheamar shello tikkenu beracha reviit ella bevirkat hammazon bilvad:

Shata yayin veachal temarim veachal tavshil shel chameshet mine dagan mevarech baacharona. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam al hammichya veal hakkalkala veal haggefen veal peri haggefen veal haetz veal peri haetz veal tenuvat hassade veal eretz chemda vechulei vechotem baruch atta Adonai al haaretz veal hammichya veal happerot:

Aval im achal basar veshata yayin mevarech bassof al ze bifne atzmo veal ze bifne atzmo. achal teenim o anavim vetappuchim vaagassim vechayyotze bahen mevarech bassof beracha achat meen shalosh vehi kolelet hakkol mippene shekkullan perot haetz. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 9: Keshem sheasur laadam lehanot bemaachol o bemashke kodem beracha. kach asur lo lehanot bereach tov kodem beracha. vechetzad mevarech al reach tov. im haya ze sheyyesh lehariach etz o min haetz mevarech bore atze besamim. veim haya esev o min haesev mevarech bore isve besamim. veim lo haya min haetz velo min haadama kegon hammor shehu min hachayya mevarech bore mine besamim. veim haya peri harauy laachila kegon etrog o tappuach mevarech shennatan reach tov bapperot. veal hakkol im amar bore mine besamim yatza:

En mevarchin al hammugmar ad shettaale timrato. vechetzad mevarchin alav. im haya ze hannisraf shennatan reach meetz mevarchin bore atze besamim. veim haya esev isve besamim. veim haya mimmin chayya vechayyotze bah mevarech alav bore mine besamim:

Shemen shel afarsemon vechayyotze bo mevarech alav bore shemen arev. aval shemen zayit shekkevasho o shettechano ad shechazar recho nodef mevarech alav bore atze besamim. shemen shebbishmo keen shemen hammishcha mevarech alav bore mine besamim. heviu lefanav shemen vahadas mevarech al hahadas ufoter et hashshemen mippene shebberacha achat lishtehen vehu atze besamim:

Hayu lefanav boshom shehu etz uvoshom shehu esev en beracha achat mehen poteret et chavero. ella mevarech al ze leatzmo veal ze leatzmo. heviu lefanav yayin veshemen ochez yayin bimino veshemen bismolo umevarech al hayyayin veshotehu vechozer umevarech al hashshemen umeriach bo vetacho berosh hashshammash. veim haya hashshammash talmid chacham tacho bakkotel:

Davar shehu safek im min haetz im min haadama mevarech alav bore mine besamim. boshom sheervo harochel mimminin harebe mevarech alav bore mine besamim. nichnas lachanuto shel bosem sheyyesh bah minin harebe mevarech alav bore mine besamim. im yashav sham kol hayyom kullo eno mevarech ella achat. nichnas veyatza nichnas veyatza mevarech al kol paam ufaam:

Hashshoshanna vachalafe hammayim mevarchin alehen bore atze besamim. nargis shel ginna bore atze besamim veshel sade bore isve besamim. havvered ume havvered vehallevona vehammastechi vechayyotze bahen bore atze besamim:
Shelosha mine reach tov en mevarchin alehen veellu hen. reach tov sheasur lehariach bo. vereach tov sheasuy lehaavir reach ra. vereach tov shello naasa lehariach beatzmo shel reach ze:

Ketzad. besamim shel akkum uvesamim shel erva min haarayot en mevarchin alehen lefi sheasur lehariach bahen. besamim shel metim uvesamim shel bet hakkisse veshemen heasuy lehaavir et hazzuhama en mevarchin alehen lefi shennaasu lehaavir reach ra. mugmar shemmegammerin bo et hakkelim veet habbegadim en mevarchin alehen lefi shello naasa lehariach beatzmo shel mugmar. vechen hammeriach bivgadim shehen megummarim eno mevarech lefi sheen sham ikkar boshom ella reach belo ikkar:

Besamim shel mesibba shel akkum en mevarchin alehem shessetam mesibbat akkum laavodat kochavim. haya mehallech chutz lakkerach veheriach reach tov. im rov hair akkum eno mevarech. veim rov yisrael mevarech. nitarev reach shemmevarchin alav berech sheen mevarchin alav holchin achare harov:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 10: Verachot acherot udevaroym acherim harebe sheen bahen peticha velo chatima tikkenu chachamim derech shevach vehodaya lehakkadosh baruch hu. kemo birchot hattefilla shekkevar ketavnum. veellu hen. habbone bayit chadash vehakkone kelim chodashim ben yesh lo kayyotze bahen ben en lo mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shehecheyanu vekiyyemanu vehiggianu lazzeman hazze:

Vechen haroe et chavero leachar sheloshim yom mevarech shehecheyanu. veim raahu leachar shenem asar chodesh mevarech baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim. haroe peri hammitchaddesh mishshana leshana bitchillat reiyyato mevarech shehecheyanu:

Shama shemua tova mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hattov vehammetiv. shama shemua raa mevarech baruch dayyan haemet. vechayyav adam levarech al haraa betuv nefesh kederech shemmevarech al hattova besimcha shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "veahavta et Adonai elohecha" vegomer <small>(Devarim 6 5)</small> "uvechol meodecha". uvichlal ahava hayetera shennitztavvenu bah sheafillu beet sheyyatzer lo yode vishabbeach besimcha:

Higgia elav tova o sheshshama shemua tova af al pi shehaddevarim marin shettova zo tigrom lo raa mevarech hattov vehammetiv. vechen im naga elav raa o shama shemua raa af al pi shehaddevarim marim sheraa zo goremet lo tova mevarech dayyan haemet. sheen mevarchin al heatid lihyot ella al ma sheera atta:

Yardu geshamim rabbim. im yesh lo sade mevarech shehecheyanu. veim hayta shello veshel acherim mevarech hattov vehammetiv. veim en lo sade mevarech modim anachnu lach Adonai elohenu al kol tippa vetippa shehoradta lanu veillu finu male kulei ad hen hem yodu vishabbechu vivarchu et shimcha malkenu baruch atta Adonai el rov hahodaot vehattishbachot:
Meematay mevarchin al haggeshamim mishsheyyirbe hammayim al haaretz veyaalu avabuot min hammatar al pene hammayim veyelchu haavabuot ze likrat ze:

Amru lo met aviv virashahu. im yesh immo achin mevarech battechilla dayyan haemet veachar kach hattov vehammetiv. veim en immo achim mevarech shehecheyanu. ketzaro shel davar kol devar tova shehi lo velaacherim mevarech hattov vehammetiv. vetova shehi lo levaddo mevarech shehecheyanu:

Arbaa tzerichin lehodot. chole shennitrappe. vechavush sheyyatza mibbet haasurim. veyorde hayyam keshealu. veholche derachim kesheyyaggiu layyishshuv. utzerichin lehodot bifne asara ushenayim mehem chachamim shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 107 32)</small> "virommuhu bikhal am uvemoshav zekenim yehalluhu". vechetzad mode vechetzad mevarech. omed benehen umevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam haggomel lechayyavim tovot sheggemalani kol tov. vechol hashshomin omrim sheggemalcha tov hu yigmalcha sela:

Haroe makom shennaasu nissim leyisrael kegon yam suf umaberot hayyarden omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa nissim laavotenu bammakom hazze. vechen kol makom shennaasu bo nissim larabbim. aval makom shennaasa bo nes layyachid oto hayyachid uveno uven beno mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa li nes bammakom hazze o sheasa nes laavotay bammakom hazze. haroe gov arayot vechivshan haesh shehushlach bo chananya mishael vaazarya mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa nes latztzaddikim bammakom hazze. haroe makom sheovdin bo akkum mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shennatan erech appayim leovre retzono. makom shenneekra mimmennu akkum im beeretz yisrael hu mevarech sheakar akkum meartzenu. veim bechutz laaretz hu mevarech sheakar akkum mimmakom hazze. veomer bishtehen keshem sheakarta mimmakom ze kach taakor mikkol mekomot vetashiv lev ovdehem leavdecha:

Haroe batte yisrael beyishshuvan mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam matztziv gevul almana. bechurbanan omer baruch dayyan haemet. haroe kivre yisrael mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher yatzar etchem baddin vedan etchem baddin vechilkel etchem bedin vehemit etchem baddin vehu atid lehakim etchem baddin lechayye haolam habba baruch atta Adonai mechayye hammetim:

Haroe shesh meot elef adam keechad. im akkum hem omer <small>(yirmeya 50 12)</small> "bosha immechem meod chafra yoladtechem hinne acharit goyim midbar tziyya vaarava". veim yisrael hem uveeretz yisrael omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam chacham harazim. haroe mechachme ummot haolam omer baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shennatan mechachmato levasar vadam. chachme yisrael mevarech shennatan mechachmato lireav. malche yisrael omer shennatan mikkevodo umiggevurato lireav. malche ummot haolam mevarech shennatan mikkevodo levasar vadam:

Haroe et hakkushi veet hameshunnin betzurat penehen o beevrehem mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam meshanne et habberiyyot. haroe suma o kittea umukke shechin uvohakanin vechayyotze bahen mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam dayyan haemet. veim noldu ken mimmee imman mevarech meshanne et habberiyyot. haroe et happil veet hakkof veet hakkifof omer baruch meshanne et habberiyyot:

Haroe beriyyot naot umetukkanot beyoter veilanot tovot mevarech shekkacha lo beolamo. hayyotze lassadot o lagginnot beyome nisan veraa ilanot porchot venitztzanim olim mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam shello chissar beolamo kelum uvara bo beriyyot tovot veilanot tovot venaot kede lehanot bahen bene adam:

Al haruchot shennashvu bezaaf veal habberakim veal haramim veal kol hahavara shettishshama baaretz kemo rechayim gedolim veal haur shebbaavir sheyyerau keillu hem kochavim noflim veratzim mimmakom lemakom o kemo kochavim sheyyesh lahem zanav al kol echad meellu mevarech baruch shekkocho ugevurato male olam. veim ratza mevarech ose bereshit:

Al heharim veal haggevaot al hayyammim veal hammidbarot veal hanneharot im raa achat mehen mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom mevarech ose bereshit. haroe et hayyam haggadol mishsheloshim yom lishloshim yom o yoter mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam sheasa et hayyam haggadol:

Haroe keshet beanan mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam zocher habberit veneeman bivrito vekayyam bemaamaro. haroe levana bechiddushah mevarech baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bemaamaro bara shechakim uveruach piv kol tzevaam chok uzeman natan lahem shello yeshannu et tafkidam sasim usemechim laasot retzon konehem poale emet ufeullatam tzedek velallevana amar shettitchaddesh atara tiferet laamuse vaten shehem atidin lehitchaddesh kemotah ulefaer leyotzram al kevod malchuto veal kol ma shebbara baruch atta Adonai mechaddesh hechodashim:

Vetzarich levarech beracha zo meummad. shekkol hamevarech al hachodesh bizmanno keillu hikbil pene hashshechina. im lo berech aleha ballayil harishon mevarech aleha ad shishsha asar yom bachodesh ad shettimmale pegimatah:

Haroe et hachamma beyom tekufat nisan shel techillat hammachazor shel shemone veesrim shana shehattekufa bitchillat lel revii kesheroe otah beyom revii babboker mevarech baruch ose bereshit. vechen keshettachazor hallevana litchillat mazzal tale bitchillat hachodesh velo tihye nota lo letzafon velo ledarom. vechen kesheyyachazor kol kochav vechochav mechameshet hakkochavim hannisharim litchillat mazzal tale velo yihye note lo letzafon velo ledarom. vechen bechol et sheyyire mazzal tale ole mikketze hammizrach al kol echad meellu mevarech ose bereshit:

Haroe batte akkum beyishshuvan omer <small>(Mishlei 15 25)</small> "bet geim yissach Adonai". bechurbanan omer <small>(Tehillim 94 1)</small> "el nekamot Adonai el nekamot hofia". raa kivre akkum omer <small>(yirmeya 50 12)</small> "bosha immechem meod" vegomer:

Hannichnas lammerchatz omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettachniseni leshalom vetotzieni leshalom vetatztzileni mizze umikkayyotze baze leatid lavo. uchesheyyetze min hammerchatz omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehitztzaltani min haur vechulei:
Hannichnas lehakkiz dam omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay sheyyehe esek ze li lirfua ki rofe chinnam atta. uchesheyyetze omer baruch atta Adonai rofe cholim:

Haholech lamod garno omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettishlach beracha bemaase yaday. hitchil lamod omer baruch hashsholeach beracha bichri ze. madad veachar kach bikkesh rachamim hare zo tefillat shav. vechol hatztzoek lesheavar hare zo tefillat shav:

Hannichnas levet hammidrash omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shello ekkashel bidvar halacha shello omar al tahor tame veal tame tahor velo al muttar asur velo al asur muttar velo ekkashel bidvar halacha veyismechu bi chaveray veal yikkashlu chaveray veesmach bahem:

Uvitziato mibbet hammidrash omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shessamta chelki miyyoshve bet hammidrash velo samta chelki miyyoshve keranot sheani mashkim vehem mashkimim ani mashkim ledivre tora vehem mashkimim lidvarim betelim ani amel vehem amelin ani amel ledivre tora umekabbel sachar vehem amelin veen mekabbelin sachar ani ratz vehem ratzim ani ratz lechayye haolam habba vehem ratzim liver shachat:

Hannichnas lichrach omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettachniseni lichrach ze leshalom. veim nichnas beshalom omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehichnastani leshalom. uchesheyyevakkesh latzet omer yehi ratzon millefanecha Adonai elohay shettotzieni mikkerach ze leshalom. veim yatza beshalom omer mode ani lefanecha Adonai elohay shehotzetani mikkerach ze leshalom ucheshem shehotzetani leshalom kach tolicheni leshalom vetatzideni leshalom vetismecheni leshalom vetatztzileni mikkaf oyev veorev badderech:

Kelalo shel davar leolam yitzak adam al heatid lavo vivakkesh rachamim veyitten hodaya al ma sheavar veyode vishabbeach kefi kocho. vechol hammarbe lehodot et Adonai uleshabbecho tamid hare ze meshubbach:
Mishneh Torah, Blessings 11: Kol habberachot kullan poteach bahem bevaruch vechotem bahem bevaruch chutz mibberacha acharona shel keriat shema uveracha hassemucha lachavertah uvirkat happerot vehaddome lah uvirkat asiyyat hammitzvot. umeellu habberachot sheamarnu shehen derech shevach vehodaya yesh mehen poteach bevaruch veeno chotem bevaruch. veyesh mehen shehu chotem bevaruch veeno poteach bevaruch, ella meat mibbirkat hammitzvot kegon birkat sefer tora veroe kivre yisrael meellu shehen derech shevach vehodaya. aval shear birchot hammitzvot kullan poteach bahen bevaruch veeno chotem:

Yesh mitzvot ase sheadam chayyav lehishtaddel velirdof ad sheyyaase otah kegon tefillin vesukka velulav veshofar veellu hen hannikrain chova. lefi sheadam chayyav al kol panim laasot. veyesh mitzva sheenah chova ella domin lirshut kegon mezuza umaake sheen adam chayyav lishkon bevayit hachayyav mezuza kede sheyyaase mezuza ella im ratza lishkon kol yamav beohel o bisfina yeshev. vechen eno chayyav livnot bayit kede laasot maake. vechol mitzvot ase shebben adam lammakom ben mitzva sheenah chova ben mitzva shehi chova mevarech aleha kodem laasiyyatah:

Vechen kol hammitzvot shehen middivre sofrim ben mitzva shehi chova middivrehem kegon mikra megilla vehadelakat ner beshabbat vehadelakat ner chanukka. ben mitzvot sheenan chova kegon eruv unetilat yadayim. mevarech al hakkol kodem laasiyyatan asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot. vehechan tzivvanu battora. shekkatuv bah <small>(Devarim 17 11)</small> "asher yomru lecha taase". nimtza inyan haddevarim vehetztzean kach hu. asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav shetztzivva bahen lishmoa meellu shetztzivvanu lehadelik ner shel chanukka o likrot et hammegilla. vechen shear kol hammitzvot shemmiddivre sofrim:

Velamma en mevarchin al netilat yadayim baacharona. mippene shello chiyyevu bedavar ze ella mippene hassakkana udevarim shehem mishshum sakkana en mevarchin alehem. ha lema ze dome lemi shessinnen et hammayim veachar kach shata ballayla mippene sakkanat aluka sheeno mevarech vetzivvanu lesannen et hammayim. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hose mitzva velo berech. im mitzva sheadayin asiyyatah kayyemet mevarech achar asiyya veim davar sheavar hu eno mevarech. ketzad. hare shennitattef betzitzit o shellavash tefillin o sheyyashav besukka velo berech techilla chozer umevarech achar shennitattef asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehitattef betzitzit. vechen mevarech achar shellavash lehaniach tefillin. veachar sheyyashav leshev bassukka. vechen kol kayyotze baellu:

Aval im shachat belo beracha eno chozer achar shechita umevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hashshechita. vechen im kissa haddam belo beracha o hifrish teruma umaasrot o shettaval velo berech eno chozer umevarech achar asiyya. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

En lecha mitzva shemmevarchin achar asiyyatah ella tevilat hagger bilvad sheeno yachol lomar asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu sheadayin lo nitkaddesh velo nitztavva ad sheyyitbol. lefichach achar sheyyitbol mevarech al hattevila mippene shehaya dachuy meikkaro velo haya rauy levarech:

Kol mitzva sheasiyyatah hi gemar chiyyuvah mevarech bishat asiyya. vechol mitzva sheyyesh achar asiyyatah tziuuy acher eno mevarech ella beshaa sheose hatztziuuy haacharon. ketzad. haose sukka o lulav o shofar o tzitzit o tefillin o mezuza eno mevarech bishat asiyya asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot sukka o lulav o lichtov tefillin mippene sheyyesh achar asiyyato tziuuy acher. veematay mevarech beshaa sheyyeshev bassukka o kesheyyenaanea hallulav o kesheyyishma kol hashshofar o kesheyyitattef batztzitzit uvishat levishat tefillin uvishat keviat mezuza. aval im asa maake mevarech bishat asiyya asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot maake. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol mitzva shehi mizzeman lizman kegon shofar vesukka velulav umikra megilla vener chanukka. vechen kol mitzva umitzva shehi kinyan lo kegon tzitzit utefillin umezuza umaake. vechen mitzva sheenah tedira veenah metzuya bechol et shehare hi doma lemitzva shehi mizzeman lizman kegon milat beno ufidyon habben, mevarech aleha bishat asiyyatah shehecheyanu. veim lo berech al sukka velulav vechayyotze bahem shehecheyanu bishat asiyya mevarech alehen shehecheyanu beshaa sheyyetze yede chovato bahen. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:

Echad haose mitzva leatzmo veechad haose otah laacherim mevarech kodem asiyyatah asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot. aval eno mevarech shehecheyanu ella al mitzva sheose otah leatzmo. hayu lefanav mitzvot harebe eno mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammitzvot ella mevarech al kol achat veachat bifne atzmah:
Kol haose mitzva ben shehayta chova alav ben sheenah chova alav im asa otah leatzmo mevarech laasot. asa otah laacherim mevarech al haasiyya:

Ketzad. lavash tefillin mevarech lehaniach tefillin. nitattef betzitzit mevarech lehitattef. yashav besukka mevarech leshev bassukka. vechen hu mevarech lehadelik ner shel shabbat veligmor et hahallel. vechen im kava mezuza leveto mevarech likboa mezuza. asa maake legaggo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu laasot maake. hifrish teruma leatzmo mevarech lehaferish. mal et beno mevarech lamul et habben. shachat pischo vachagigato mevarech lishchot:

Aval im kava mezuza laacherim mevarech al keviat mezuza. asa lahem maake mevarech al asiyyat maake. hifrish lahem teruma mevarech al haferashat teruma. mal et ben chavero mevarech al hammila. vechen kol kayyotze beellu:

Asa hammitzva lo velaacherim keechad im hayta mitzva sheenah chova mevarech al haasiyya. lefichach hu mevarech al mitzvat eruv. hayta chova venitkavven lehotzi atzmo mide chova ulehotzi acherim mevarech laasot. lefichach hu mevarech lishmoa kol shofar:

Natal et hallulav mevarech al netilat lulav shekkevan shehigbiho yatza yede chovato. aval im berech kodem sheyyittol mevarech littol lulav kemo leshev bassukka. mikkan atta lamed shehamevarech achar sheasa mevarech al haasiyya. aval netilat yadayim ushechita hoil uvedivre harshut hen afillu shachat leatzmo mevarech al hashshechita veal kissuy haddam veal netilat yadayim. vechach hu mevarech al biur chametz ben shebbadak leatzmo ben shebbadak laacherim shemmishshaa sheggamar belibbo levattel naaset mitzvat habbiur kodem sheyyivdok kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo:

Kol davar shehu minhag af al pi shemminhag neviim hu kegon netilat arava bishvii shel chag veen tzarich lomar minhag chachamim kegon keriat hallel berashe chodashim uvechullo shel moed shel pesach en mevarchin alav. vechen kol davar sheyyistappek lecha im taun beracha im lav osin oto belo beracha. uleolam yizzaher adam bivracha sheenah tzericha veyarbe babberachot hatztzerichot. vechen david amar (Tehillim 145 2) "bechol yom avarchekka":
selik hilchot berachot
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 1: Mila mitzvat ase shechayyavin aleha karet shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 17 14)</small> "vearel zachar asher lo yimmol et besar arlato venichreta hannefesh hahiv meammeha". umitzva al haav lamul et beno veal harav lamul et avadav <small>(Bereshit 17 12)</small> "yelid bayit umiknat kesef". avar haav o haadon velo mal otan bittel mitzvat ase veeno chayyav karet sheen hakkaret taluy ella bearel atzmo. uvet din metzuvvim lamul oto habben o haeved bizmanno velo yannichu arel beyisrael velo beavdehen:

En malin beno shel adam shello middato ella im ken avar venimna lemulo shebbet din malin oto beal karcho. nitallem mibbet din velo malu oto. kesheyyigdal hu chayyav lamul et atzmo. vechol yom veyom sheyyaavor alav mishsheyyigdal velo yamul et atzmo hare hu mevattel mitzvat ase. aval eno chayyav karet ad sheyyamut vehu arel bemezid:

Echad eved shennolad birshut yisrael veechad eved hannilkach min hakkutim chayyav harav lamul otan. ella sheyyelid bayit nimmol lishmona. umiknat kesef nimmol bayyom shennilkach afillu lekacho bayyom shennolad nimmol beyomo:

Yesh miknat kesef shennimmol lishmona veyesh yelid bayit shennimmol bayyom shennolad. ketzad. lakach shifcha velakach ubbarah immah veyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona. veaf al pi shellakach haubbar bifne atzmo vahare haubbar atzmo miknat kesef hoil vekana immo kodem shennolad nimmol lishmona:

Lakach shifcha leubbareha. o shellakach shifcha al menat shello lehatebilah leshem avdut. af al pi shennolad birshuto nimmol bayyom shennolad. shehare hannolad hazze keillu hu miknat kesef levaddo ucheillu hayyom kanahu. sheen immo bichlal shifchot yisrael kede sheyyihye habben yelid bayit. veim tavla immo achar sheyyalda hare ze nimmol lishmona:

Lakach eved gadol min haakkum velo ratza haeved lamul megalgelin immo kol shenem asar chodesh. yeter al ken asur lekayyemo keshehu arel. ella chozer umochro leakkum. veim hitna alav mittechilla vehu etzel rabbo haakkum shello yamul oto muttar lekayyemo vehu arel. uvilvad sheyyekabbel alav sheva mitzvot shennitztauu bene noach veyihye keger toshav. aval im lo kibbel alav sheva mitzvot yehareg miyyad. veen mekabbelim ger toshav ella bizman shehayyovel noheg:

Ger shennichnas likhal yisrael chayyav mila techilla. veim mal keshehaya akkum tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom shennitgayyer. vechen katan shennolad keshehu mahul tzarich lehattif mimmennu dam berit bayyom hashshemini. anderoginus vehu hayyalud sheyyesh lo zachrut kezachar venakvut kinkeva tzarich lamul oto bashshemini. vechen yotze dofen umi sheyyesh lo shete arlot malin et shetehen bashshemini:

En malin leolam ella bayyom achar alot hashshemesh. ben bayyom hashshemini shehu zemannah ben shello bizmannah shehu mitteshii vahala shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 12 3)</small> "bayyom hashshemini" bayyom velo ballayla. mal mishsheala ammud hashshachar kasher. vechol hayyom kasher lemila. veaf al pi chen mitzva lehakedim bitchillat hayyom shezzerizin makdimin lemitzvot:

Mila bizmannah docha et hashshabbat. veshello bizmannah enah docha lo et hashshabbat velo et yom tov. uven bizmannah uven shello bizmannah docha et hatztzaraat. ketzad. sheim hayta baheret beor haarla chotchah im haarla. af al pi shekketzitzat nega hatztzaraat belo taase yavo ase veyidche et lo taase:

Keshem shemmilat habbanim docha et hashshabbat kach milat haavadim shehen nimmolim lishmona docha et hashshabbat im chal shemini shellahen beshabbat. chutz milid bayit shello tavla immo ad sheyyalda sheaf al pi shennimmol lishmona eno doche et hashshabbat:

Katan shennolad keshehu mahul. umi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini leibburo kodem shettiggamer beriyyato shehu kenefel mippene sheeno chay. veyotze dofen veanderoginus umi sheyyesh lo shete arlot en dochin et hashshabbat ella nimolin beechad beshabbat shehu yom teshii shellahen:

Mi shennolad ben hashshemashot safek bayyom safek ballayla monin min hallayla venimmol litshii shehu safek shemini. veim nolad erev shabbat ben hashshemashot eno doche et hashshabbat ella nimmol beechad beshabbat. sheen dochin et hashshabbat missafek:

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshemini. im haya shalem bisaro uvetzipparnav hare ze valad shalem uven shiva hu ella shennishtaha. umuttar letaltelo beshabbat veeno keeven. umalin oto beshabbat. aval im nolad usearo lakuy veen tzipparnav shelemin kivriyyatan hare ze ben shemona vadday shello haya rauy lehivvaled ella betisha veyatza kodem sheyyiggamer. ulefichach hu chashuv keeven veasur letaltelo beshabbat. veaf al pi chen im shaha sheloshim yom hare hu valad shel kayyama. vahare hu kishar hannoladin lechol davar. shekkol sheshshaha sheloshim yom baadam eno nefel:

Mi shennolad bachodesh hashshevii leibburo im nolad shalem hare ze valad shel kayyama umalin oto beshabbat. safek ben shiva safek ben shemona malin oto beshabbat al kol panim. im ben shiva hu veshalem hu bedin hu sheyyidche shabbat. veim ben shemona hu hare ze shemmal kimchattech basar hu lefi shezze nefel im hu ben shemona:

Hotzi haubbar rosho chutz lime immo ben hashshemashot af al pi shello yatza kullo ella belele shabbat en malin oto beshabbat. vechol mi sheeno doche et hashshabbat eno doche et yom tov rishon vedoche et yom tov sheni. uvishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana eno doche lo et harishon velo et hashsheni. vechen mila shello bizmannah enah docha et shene yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana:

Chole en malin oto ad sheyyavri. umonin lo meet sheyyavri mechalyo shiva yamim meet leet veachar kach malin oto. bamme devarim amurim beshechalatzto chamma vechayyotze becholi ze. aval im kaavu lo enav beet sheyyippatchu enav veyerafu malin oto miyyad. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Katan shennimtza bashshemini shello yarok beyoter en malin oto ad sheyyippol bo dam veyachzeru marav kemare hakketannim habberiim. vechen im haya adom beyoter kemi shetztzavu oto en malin oto ad sheyyibbala bo damo veyachzeru marav kishar hakketannim mippene shezze choli hu. vetzarich lehizzaher bidvarim ellu harebe:

Ishsha shemmala benah rishon umet mechamat mila shehichshila et kocho. vechen mala et hashsheni umet mechamat mila. ben mibbaalah harishon ben mibbaalah hashsheni hare ze lo yamul et hashshelishi bizmanno. ella mamtinin lo ad sheyyagdil veyitchazzek kocho. en malin ella valad sheen bo shum choli. shessakkanat nefashot docha et hakkol. veefshar lamul leachar zeman vei efshar lehachazir nefesh achat miyyisrael leolam:
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 2: Hakkol kesherin lamul. vaafillu arel veeved veishsha vekatan malin bemakom sheen sham ish. aval akkum lo yamul kelal. veim mal eno tzarich lachazor velamul sheniyya. uvakkol malin vaafillu betzur uvizchuchit uvechol davar shekkoret. velo yamul bikrumit shel kane mippene hassakkana. umitzva min hammuvchar lamul bevarzel ben besakkin ben bemisparayim. venahagu kol yisrael besakkin:

Ketzad mohalin. chotchin et kol haor hamechappe et haatara ad shettitgalle kol haatara. veachar kach porin et hakkerum harach shellematta min haor betzipporen umachaziro lechan ulechan ad sheyyerae besar haatara. veachar kach motzetz et hammila ad sheyyetze haddam mimmekomot rechokim kede shello yavo lide sakkana. vechol mi sheeno motzetz maavirin oto. veachar shemmotzetz noten aleha ispelanit o retiyya vechayyotze bahen:

Yesh tzitzin meakkevin et hammila veyesh tzitzin sheen meakkevin et hammila. ketzad. im nishar meor haarla or hachofe rov gavhah shel atara hare ze arel kemot shehaya. veze haor hu tzitz hameakkev. veim lo nishar mimmennu ella meat sheeno chofe rov gavhah shel atara zehu tzitz sheeno meakkev:

Hammal kol zeman sheosek bammila chozer ben al hatztzitzin shemmeakkevin ben al tzitzin sheen meakkevin. perash, al tzitzin hameakkevin chozer, al tzitzin sheenan meakkevin eno chozer. mal velo para et hammila keillu lo mal:

Katan shebbesaro rach umeduldal beyoter o shehaya baal basar ad sheyyerae keillu eno mahul roin oto beet sheyyitkashshe. im nire shehu mahul eno tzarich kelum. vetzarich letakken et habbasar mikkan umikkan mippene marit haayin. veim beet sheyyitkashshe lo nire mahul chozrin vekotztzin et habbasar hameduldal mikkan umikkan ad shetterae haatara geluya beet kishshuy. vedavar ze middivre sofrim. aval min hattora af al pi shehu nire kearel hoil umal eno tzarich lamul paam sheniyya:

Osin kol tzarche mila beshabbat. malin uforin umotztzin. vechozer al tzitzin hameakkevin af al pi shepperash veal tzitzin sheen meakkevin kol zeman shello perash. venoten aleha ispelanit. aval machshire mila enan dochin et hashshabbat. ketzad. hare shello matzu sakkin en osin sakkin beshabbat velo meviin oto mimmakom lemakom. vaafillu mavoy sheeno meorav en meviin oto mechatzer lechatzer. veen eruv middivrehem nidche mippene havaat hassakkin hoil veefshar lahavio meerev shabbat:

Vechen en shochakin lah sammanin veen mechimmin lah chammin. veen osin lah ispelanit. veen torfin yayin veshemen. veim lo shachak kammon meerev shabbat loes beshinnav venoten. veim lo taraf yayin veshemen noten ze leatzmo veze leatzmo. ze hakkelal, kol sheefshar laasoto meerev shabbat eno doche et hashshabbat. aval im shachach velo hechinu hammachshirin tiddache hammila litshii:

Malu et hakkatan beshabbat veachar kach nishpechu hachammin o nitpazzeru hassammanin osin lo hakkol beshabbat mippene shessakkana hi lo. makom sheddarkan leharechitz et hakkatan marchitzin oto beshabbat beyom hammila ben lifne hammila ben leachar hammila, o bashshelishi shel mila shechal lihyot beshabbat. ben rechitzat kol gufo. ben rechitzat mila. ben bechammin shehuchammu meerev shabbat ben bechammin shehuchammu beshabbat. mippene shessakkana hi lo:

Shachchu velo heviu sakkin meerev shabbat omer leakkum lehavi sakkin beshabbat. uvilvad shello yavi oto derech reshut harabbim. kelalo shel davar kol davar sheasiyyato beshabbat asura alenu mishshum shevut muttar lanu lomar leakkum laasot otan kede laasot mitzva bizmannah. vedavar sheasiyyato asura alenu mishshum melacha asur lanu lomar leakkum laasoto beshabbat:

Machshire mila afillu bizmannah enan dochin et yom tov hoil veefshar laasotan meerev yom tov. vekal vachomer haddevarim, im lo dachu machshire mila shevut shehu middivrehem heach yidchu lo taase shebbattora. aval shochakin lah sammanin beyom tov hoil verauy likdera. vetorfin lah yayin veshemen:
Mishneh Torah, Circumcision 3: Hammal mevarech kodem sheyyamul asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu al hammila, im mal ben chavero. veim mal et beno mevarech vetzivvanu lamul et habben. vaavi habben mevarech beracha acheret. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lehacheniso bivrito shel avraham avinu. mitzva al haav lamul et beno yater al mitzva shemmetzuvvin yisrael sheyyamulu kol arel shebbenehen. lefichach im en sham aviv en mevarchin achareha beracha zo. veyesh mi shehora sheyyevarchu otah bet din o echad min haam. veen rauy laasot ken:
Veim hayu sham omdin omrim keshem shehichnasto labberit ken tachnisehu letora ulechuppa ulemaasim tovim:

Veachar kach mevarech avi habben o hammal o echad min haomdin sham. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddash yedid mibbeten vechok bishero sam vetzeetzaav chatam beot berit kodesh al ken bischar zot el chay chelkenu tzurenu tzavve lehatztzil yedidut sheerenu mishshachat lemaan berito asher sam bivsarenu. baruch atta Adonai koret habberit. vaavi habben mevarech shehecheyanu:

Hammal et haggerim mevarech. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haggerim ulehattif mimmennu dam berit sheilmale dam habberit lo nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz shenneemar <small>(yirmeya log ko)</small> "im lo veriti yomam valayla chukkot shamayim vaaretz lo samti":

Hammal et avdo mevarech asher kiddeshanu bemitzvotav vetzivvanu lamul et haavadim ulehattif mehen dam berit sheilmale dam berit lo nitkayyemu shamayim vaaretz. veim mal eved shel acherim mevarech al milat haavadim. vehammal adam gadol tzarich lechassot ervato ad sheyyevarech veachar kach megallehu umal oto:
Ger shemmal kodem shennitgayyer vekatan shennolad keshehu mahul keshemmattifin mimmennu dam berit enan tzerichin beracha. vechen anderoginus en mevarchin al millato mippene shehu eno zachar vadday:

Akkum shetztzarich lachtoch arlato mippene makka o mippene shechin shennolad bo haya asur leyisrael lachtoch lo otah, shehaakkum en maalim otam mide mita velo moridin otan eleha, af al pi shennaaset mitzva birfua zo, shehare lo nitkavven lemitzva. lefichach im nitkavven haakkum lemila muttar leyisrael lamul oto:

Meusa hi haarla shennitgannu bah haggoyim shenneemar <small>(yirmeya 9 25)</small> "ki kol haggoyim arelim". ugedola hi hammila shello nikra avraham avinu shalem ad shemmal shenneemar <small>(Bereshit 17 1)</small> "hithallech lefanay vehye tamim" <small>(Bereshit 17 2)</small> "veettena veriti beni uvenecha" vegomer. vechol hammefer berito shel avraham avinu vehinniach arlato o meshachah af al pi sheyyesh bo tora umaasim tovim en lo chelek laolam habba:

Bo uree kamma chamura mila shello nitla lemoshe rabbenu aleha afillu shaa achat af al pi shehaya badderech. vechol mitzvot hattora nichretu alehen shalosh beritot. shenneemar (Devarim 28 69) "elle divre habberit asher tzivva Adonai", (Devarim 28 69) "millevad habberit asher karat ittam bechorev". vesham hu omer (Devarim 29 9) "attem nitztzavim hayyom kullechem" (Devarim 29 11) "leavrecha bivrit Adonai elohecha", hare shalosh beritot. veal hammila nichretu shelosh esre beritot im avraham avinu. (Bereshit 17 2) "veettena veriti beni uvenecha". (Bereshit 17 4) "ani hinne veriti ittach". vahakimoti et beriti beni uvenecha. livrit olam. (Bereshit 17 9) "veatta et beriti tishmor". (Bereshit 17 10) "zot beriti asher tishmeru". (Bereshit 17 11) "vehaya leot berit". (Bereshit 17 13) "vehayta veriti bivsarchem". livrit olam. (Bereshit 17 14) "et beriti hefar". (Bereshit 17 19) "vahakimoti et beriti itto. livrit olam". (Bereshit 17 21) "veet beriti akim et yitzchak":
berich rachamana desayyean
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 1: Nahagu haam likrot bechol yom bashshachar achar shekkorin parashat tzav uvirkat kohanim korin mishna zo. ellu devarim sheen lahem shiur happea vehabbikkurim vehareayon ugemilut chasadim vetalmud tora. ellu devarim sheadam ochel perotehen baolam hazze vehakkeren kayyemet lo laolam habba. kibbud av vaem ugemilut chasadim veiyyun tefilla uvikkur cholim vehashekamat bet hammidrash vehachenasat orchim vahavaat shalom ben adam lachavero vetalmud tora keneged kullam. amar rabbi zera benot yisrael hen hechmiru al atzman sheafillu root tippat dam kechardal yoshvot aleha shiva nekiyyim. tana deve eliyyahu kol hashshone halachot bechol yom muvtach lo shehu ben haolam habba shenneemar halichot olam lo al tikre halichot ella halachot. amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi chanina talmide chachamim marbim shalom baolam shenneemar vechol banayich limmude Adonai vechulei. mizmor ledavid Adonai mi yagur beoholecha mi yishkon behar kadshecha holech tamim ufoel tzedek. leolam yehe adam yere shamayim basseter umode al haemet vedover emet bilvavo veyashkem veyomar. ribbon haolamim lo al tzidkotenu anachnu mappilim tachanunenu lefanecha ki al rachamecha harabbim ma anu me chayyenu ma chasdenu ma tzidkatenu ma kochenu uma gevuratenu ma nomar lefanecha Adonai elohenu halo kol haggibborim keayin lefanecha veanshe hashshem kelo hayu vachachamim kivli madda unevonim kivli hasekel ki chol maasenu tohu vavohu vime chayyenu hevel lefanecha kemo shekkatuv bedivre kadshecha umotar haadam vegomer. aval anachnu ammecha bene veritecha bene avraham ohavcha shennishbata lo behar hammoriyya. zera yitzchak yechidcha shenneekad al gabbe mizbechecha. adat yaakov bincha bechorecha shemmeahavatcha sheahavta oto umissimchatcha shessamachta bo karata oto yisrael vishurun.

Lefichach anu chayyavin lehodot lecha uleshabbechacha ulefaercha velitten shevach vehodaa lishmecha. vechayyavin anu lomar lefanecha bechol yom erev vavoker shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. ashrenu ma tov chelkenu ma naim goralenu ma yafa yerushshatenu. ashrenu sheanu mashkimin umaarivin bechol yom tamid erev vavoker veomrim shema yisrael Adonai elohenu Adonai echad. atta hu kodem shennivra haolam atta hu achar shennivra haolam atta hu baolam hazze veatta hu laolam habba atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon. kaddesh shimcha haggadol vehakkadosh beolamecha uvishuatcha tarum vetagbiah karnenu baruch hamekaddesh shemo barabbim. atta hu Adonai elohenu bashshamayim mimmaal veal haaretz mittachat uvishme hashshamayim haelyonim. atta hu rishon veatta hu acharon umibbaladecha en elohim kabbetz koycha mearba kanfot haaretz yakkiru veyedu kol bae olam ki atta hu haelohim levaddecha lechol mamlechot haaretz atta asita et hashshamayim veet haaretz umi bechol maase yadecha baelyonim o vattachtonim mi sheyyomar lecha ma taase. avinu shebbashshamayim ase immanu kemo shehivtachtanu al yede chozecha baet hahi avi etchem uvaet kabbetzi etchem ki etten etchem leshem velithilla bechol amme haaretz beshuvi et shevutechem leenechem amar Adonai. veneemar atta hu Adonai levaddecha atta asita et hashshamayim sheme hashshamayim vechol tzevaam haaretz vechol asher aleha hayyammim vechol asher bahem veatta mechayye et kullam utzeva hashshamayim lecha mishtachavim. atta hu Adonai haelohim asher bacharta beavram vehotzeto meur kasdim vesamta shemo avraham. atta hu ushenotecha lo yittammu. Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed. Adonai melech kulei ad baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen:

Beracha rishona shemmevarchin lifne pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah. baruch sheamar vehaya haolam baruch hu baruch omer veose baruch gozer umekayyem baruch merachem al haaretz baruch merachem al habberiyyot baruch maavir afela umevi ora baruch meshallem sachar tov lireav baruch sheen lefanecha lo avla lo shichcha velo kazav velo mirma lo masso fanim velo mikkach shochad baruch el chay laad vekayyam lanetzach. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam hael hamehullal befi ammo meshubbach umefoar bilshon kol chasidav vaavadav uveshire david avdecha meshichecha nehallelcha Adonai elohenu bishvachot uvizmirot nodecha uneshabbechacha unefaercha venazkir shimcha malkenu elohenu yachid che haolamim meshubbach umefoar ade ad shemo baruch atta Adonai melech mehullal battishbachot. vekorin pesukin ellu yehi chevod Adonai leolam yismach Adonai bemaasav kulei ashre kulei ad sof tillim. veachar kach kore pesukim ellu baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen. yimloch Adonai leolam amen veamen. vayvarech david et Adonai leene kol hakkahal vayyomer david baruch atta Adonai elohe yisrael vechulei:

Beracha acharona shel achar pesuke hazzemirot zehu nuschah. yishtabbach shimcha laad malkenu hael hammelech haggadol vehakkadosh bashshamayim uvaaretz ki lecha nae Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu vechulei. vekore hashshira ad sofah keminhag hammakom. beshabbat nahagu kol haam lehosif lifne beracha zo nosach ze. nishmat kol chay tevarech et shimcha Adonai elohenu veruach kol basar tefaer uteromem zichrecha malkenu tamid ledor vador umeolam vead olam atta el umibbaladecha en elohim veen lanu melech goel umoshia pode umatztzil bechol et tzara vetzuka ella atta mefarnes umerachem eloah kol beriyyot adon hattoladot hamehullal battishbachot hamenaheg olamo bechesed uveriyyotav berachamim rabbim. elohim emet lo yanum velo yishan hameorer yeshenim vehammekitz nirdamim somech noflim verofe cholim umattir asurim ulecha anachnu modim. veillu finu male shira kayyam uleshonenu rinna kahamon gallav vesiftotenu shevach kemerchave rakia veenenu meirot kashshemesh vechayyareach veyadenu perusot kenishre shamayim veraglenu kallot kaayyalot en anu maspikin lehodot lecha Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu ulevarech et shemecha al achat meelef alfe alafim verov rubbe revavot peamim hattovot nissim ugevurot sheasita immanu veim avotenu. millefanim mimmitzrayim gealtanu Adonai elohenu mibbet avadim peditanu. baraav zantanu uvesava kilkaltanu. mecherev hitztzaltanu umiddever millattanu umecholaim raim rabbim dillitanu. vead henna azarunu rachamecha Adonai elohenu velo azavunu chasadecha al ken evarim sheppillagta banu veruach uneshama shennafachta beappenu velashon asher samta befinu hen hem yodu vivarchu et shimcha Adonai elohenu vechulei yishtabbach vechulei. vechen nahagu likrot kol mizmor shir leyom hashshabbat kodem sheyyatchilu pesuke hazzemirot beyom hashshabbat uveyom hakkippurim. veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot hallel haggadol beshabbatot kodem pesuke hazzemirot. veyesh mekomot shennahagu likrot shir hammaalot hakkol keminhagam:

Beracha rishona shellifne keriat shema zo hi nuschah. baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam yotzer or uvore choshech kulei ad yotzer hammeorot. beracha sheniyya ahavat olam ahavtanu Adonai elohenu chemla gedola vitera chamalta alenu avinu malkenu kulei ad beammo yisrael beahava:

Beracha acharona shelleachar keriat shema zo hi nuschah. emet veyatztziv vechulei ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael. uvearvit beracha rishona baruch atta Adonai elohenu melech haolam asher bidvaro maariv aravim ad baruch atta Adonai hammaariv aravim. beracha sheniyya ahavat olam bet yisrael ammecha ahavta vechulei ad baruch atta Adonai ohev ammo yisrael.
Beracha rishona shelleachar keriat shema shel arvit zo hi nuschah. emet veemuna kol zot kayyam alenu kulei ad baruch atta Adonai gaal yisrael.

Beracha acharona zo hi nuschah. hashekivenu Adonai elohenu leshalom vechulei ad baruch shomer ammo yisrael laad. baruch Adonai leolam amen veamen kulei ad padita oti Adonai el emet. yiru enenu veyismach libbenu kulei ad Adonai melech Adonai malach Adonai yimloch leolam vaed.

Venahagu miktzat haam levarech pesukim beemtza beracha vekorin benosach ze. vayyar kol haam vayyippelu al penehem vayyomru Adonai hu haelohim Adonai hu haelohim. hoshienu elohe yishenu vekabbetzenu vehatztzilenu min haggoyim lehodot leshem kadshecha lehishtabbeach bithillatecha. ki lo yittosh Adonai et ammo baavur shemo haggadol ki hoil Adonai laasot etchem lo leam vealu moshiim behar tziyyon lishpot et har esav vehayta laAdonai hammelucha vehaya Adonai lemelech al kol haaretz bayyom hahu yihye Adonai echad ushemo echad. elohenu shebbashshamayim yached shimcha hakkaruy alenu kayyem et shemecha umalchutecha alenu tamid. beyadcha nafshot hachayyim vehammetim asher beyado nefesh kol chay veruach kol besar ish beyadcha afkid ruchi padita oti Adonai el emet. vaanachnu ammecha vetzon maritecha node lecha leolam ledor vador nesapper tehillatecha. Adonai hatztzila nafshi missefat sheker millashon remiyya. yisrael nosha baAdonai teshuat olamim lo tevoshu velo tikkalmu ad olme ad. yehi Adonai elohenu immanu kaasher haya im avotenu al yaazvenu veal yitteshenu lehattot levavenu elav lalechet bechol derachav lishmor mitzvotav vechukkav umishpatav asher tzivva et avotenu. kol hanneshama tehallel yah haleluyah. baruch Adonai bayyom baruch Adonai ballayla baruch Adonai beshachvenu baruch Adonai bekumenu tamid nehallelcha sela venasiach bechukkecha uveemunatecha. baruch atta Adonai hammolech bichvodo chay vekayyam tamid yimloch alenu vechulei:
Mishneh Torah, The Order of Prayer 2: Nosach berachot hattefilla vasedaveran
(1) Baruch atta Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu elohe avraham elohe yitzchak velohe yaakov hael haggadol haggibbor vehannora vechulei:
(2) Atta gibbor leolam adonay mechayye metim atta rav lehoshia (morid hattal) (mashshiv haruach umorid haggashem) mechalkel chayyim bechesed mechayye metim berachamim rabbim somech noflim vechulei:
(3) Atta kadosh veshimcha kadosh ukedoshim bechol yom yehallucha sela baruch atta Adonai hael hakkadosh:
(4) Atta chonen leadam daat umelammed leenosh bina vechannenu meittecha dea chachma uvina vehasekel baruch atta Adonai chonen haddaat:
(5) Hashivenu avinu letoratecha vedabbekenu bemitzvotecha vekarvenu malkenu laavodatecha vehachazirenu bitshuva shelema lefanecha baruch atta Adonai harotze bitshuva:
(6) Selach lanu avinu ki chatanu mechol lanu malkenu ki pashanu lecha ki el tov vesallach atta baruch atta Adonai channun hammarbe lisloach:
(7) Ree na veanyenu veriva rivenu vedun dinenu umaher legoolenu ki el melech goel chazak atta baruch atta Adonai goel yisrael:
(8) Refaenu Adonai elohenu venerafe hoshienu venivvashea ki tehillatenu atta vehaale refua shelema lechol tachaluenu ki el rofe verachaman atta baruch atta Adonai rofe chole ammo yisrael:

(9) Barchenu Adonai elohenu bechol maase yadenu uvarech et shenotenu veten (tal umatar li) beracha al kol pene haadama vesabba et haolam mibbirchotecha veravve pene tevel baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim:
(10) Teka beshofar gadol lecherutenu vesa nes lekabbetz et kol galuyyotenu mearba kanfot kol haaretz leartzenu baruch atta Adonai mekabbetz niddeche ammo yisrael:

(11) Hashiva shoftenu kevarishona veyoatzenu kevattechilla vehaser mimmennu yagon vaanacha umeloch alenu atta levaddecha bechesed uverachamim betzedek uvemishpat baruch atta Adonai melech ohev tzedaka umishpat:
(12) Lammalshinim al tehi tikva vechol haeppikorosin kullam kerega yovedu umalchut zadon teakker uteshabber bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai shover reshaim umachnia zedim:
(13) Al hachasidim veal hatztzaddikim veal gere hatztzedek veal sheerit ammecha bet yisrael yehemu rachamecha Adonai elohenu veten sachar tov lechol habbotchim beshimcha beemet vechulei:
(14) Tishkon betoch yerushalayim ircha kaasher dibbarta uvene otah binyan olam bimhera veyamenu baruch atta Adonai bone yerushalayim:
(15) Et tzemach david bimhera tatzmiach vekarno tarum bishuatecha baruch atta Adonai matzmiach keren yeshua:
(16) Shema kolenu Adonai elohenu vechus verachem alenu vekabbel berachamim uveratzon et tefillatenu malkenu rekam al teshivenu ki atta shomea vechulei:
(17) Retze Adonai elohenu beammecha yisrael velitfillatam shee vehashev haavoda lidvir betecha veishshe yisrael utefillatam vechulei baruch atta Adonai hammachazir shechinato letziyyon:
(18) Modim anachnu lach shaatta hu Adonai elohenu velohe avotenu tzur chayyenu umagen yishenu atta ledor vador node lecha unesapper tehillatecha al chayyenu vechulei:
(19) Sim shalom tova uveracha chen vachesed verachamim alenu veal yisrael ammecha uvarchenu kullanu mimmeor panecha natatta lanu Adonai elohenu tora vechayyim ahava vechulei.

Bimot hachamma omer bivracha sheniyya rav lehoshia morid hattal mechalkel chayyim bechesed vechulei. umevarech beracha teshiit benosach ze barchenu Adonai elohenu bechol maase yadenu uvarech et shenatenu betalle ratzon beracha unedava kashshanim hattovot baruch atta Adonai mevarech hashshanim.

Belel motzae shabbat uvemotzae yom hakkippurim uvemotzae yamim tovim mevarech beracha reviit benosach ze. atta chonen leadam daat umelammed leenosh bina atta hivdalta ben kodesh lechol ben or lechoshech ben yisrael laammim ben yom hashshevii lesheshet yeme hammaase keshem shehivdalta ben kodesh lechol ken pedenu vehatztzilenu mikkol mine mashchit umikkol mine furanuyyot hammitraggeshot lavo baolam veshamrenu min hakkol vechannenu meittecha vechulei.
