Mi shehaya ba badderech vekadash alav hayyom vehayu immo maot noten kiso lenachri leholicho lo ulemotzae shabbat lokcho mimmennu. veaf al pi shello natan lo sachar al ze. veaf al pi shennetano lo mishshechashecha muttar mippene sheadam bahul al mamono vei efshar sheyyashlichennu. veim lo tattir lo davar ze sheen issuro ella middivre sofrim yavo lahavio beyado veover al melacha shel tora. bamme devarim amurim bechiso aval metzia lo yitten lannachri ella molichah befachot pachot mearba ammot:

Yisrael sheasa melacha beshabbat im avar veasa bezadon asur lo lehanot beotah melacha leolam. ushear yisrael muttar lahem lehanot bah lemotzae shabbat miyyad shenneemar <small>(Shemot lo 14)</small> "ushemartem et hashshabbat ki kodesh hi", hi kodesh veen maaseha kodesh. ketzad. yisrael shebbishshel beshabbat bemezid. lemotzae shabbat yeachel laacherim aval lo lo yeachel olamit. veim bishshel bishgaga lemotzae shabbat yochal ben hu ben acherim miyyad. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Perot sheyyatzu chutz lattechum vechazru. beshogeg yeachlu beshabbat shehare lo naasa begufan maase velo nishtannu. bemezid lo yeachlu ad motzae shabbat:

Hassocher et happoel lishmor lo et happara veet hattinok lo yitten lo secharo shel shabbat. lefichach en acharayut shabbat alav. veim haya hassachir sechir shabbat o sechir shana noten lo secharo mashlam. lefichach acharayut shabbat alav. velo yomar lo ten li sechari shel shabbat ella omer lo ten li sechari shel shana o shel asara yamim:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7:
Melachot shechayyavin alehen sekila vecharet bemezid o karban chattat bishgaga. mehen avot umehen toladot. uminyan kol avot melachot arbaim chaser achat. veellu hen. hacharisha. vehazzeria. vehakketzira. vehaimmur. vehaddisha. vehazzeriyya. vehabberira. vehattechina. vehaharkada. vehallisha. vehaafiyya. vehaggeziza. vehallibbun. vehannipputz. vehatztzevia. vehatteviyya. vaasiyyat hannirin. vehanesachat hammassecha. vehaariga. vehabbetzia. vehakkeshira. vehahattara. vehattefira. vehakkeria. vehabbinyan. vehassetira. vehakkaa befattish. vehatztzida. vehashshechita. vehahafshata. vehahaavada. umechikat haor. vechittucho. vehakketiva. vehammechika. vehassirtut. vehahavara. vehakkibbuy. vehahotzaa mershut lirshut: 
Kol ellu hammelachot vechol shehu meinyanam hem hannikrain avot melachot. ketzad hu inyanan. echad hachoresh o hachofer o haose charitz hare ze av melacha. shekkol achat veachat mehen chafira bakkarka veinyan echad hu: 
Vechen hazzorea zeraim o hannotea ilanot o hammavrich ilanot o hammarkiv o hazzomer. kol ellu av echad hen meavot melachot veinyan echad hu. shekkol achat mehen letzammeach davar hu mitkavven: 
Vechen hakkotzer tevua o kitnit o habbotzer anavim o haggoder temarim o hammosek zetim o haore teenim. kol ellu av melacha achat hen. shekkol achat mehen laakor davar miggiddulav mitkavven. veal derech zo shear haavot: 
Hattolada hi hammelacha haddoma leav meellu haavot. ketzad. hamechattech et hayyarak meat levashshelo hare ze chayyav shezzo hammelacha toledet techina. shehattochen lokeach guf echad umechalleko legufim harebe. vechol haose davar haddome laze hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hallokeach lashon shel mattechet veshaf oto kede likkach meafaro kederech sheosim tzorfe hazzahav hare ze toledet techina: 
Vechen hallokeach chalav venatan bo keva kede lechavtzo hare ze chayyav mishshum toledet borer shehare hifrish hakkom min hechalav. veim gibbeno veasahu gevina chayyav mishshum bone. shekkol hamekabbetz chelek el chelek vedibbek hakkol ad sheyyeasu guf echad hare ze dome levinyan. vechen lechol melacha umelacha meellu haavot yesh lahen toladot al derech zo sheamarnu. umigguf hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat teda meen e ze av hi vetoledet e ze av hi: 
Echad haose av meavot melachot o tolada min hattoladot bemezid chayyav karet. veim bau edim niskal. beshogeg chayyav chattat kevua. im ken ma hefresh yesh ben haavot vehattoladot. en benehen hefresh ella leinyan hakkarban bilvad. shehaose beshogeg im asa avot harebe behealem echad chayyav chattat achat al kol av veav. veim asa av vetoldotav behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat: 
Ketzad. hare shecharash vezara vekatzar beshabbat behealem echad chayyav shalosh chattaot. vaafillu asa haarbaim chaser achat bishgaga kegon sheshshachach sheellu hammelachot asurot leasot beshabbat chayyav al kol melacha umelacha chattat achat. aval im tachan vechatach hayyarak veshaf lashon shel mattechet behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. shehare lo asa ella av echad vetoldotav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat. ketzad. hare shezzara venata vehivrich vehirkiv vezamar behealem echad eno chayyav ella chattat achat shekkullan av echad hen. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 8:
Hachoresh kol shehu chayyav. hamenakkesh beikkere hailanot vehamekarsem asavim o hamezared et hassarigim kede leyappot et hakkarka hare ze toledet choresh umishsheyyaase kol shehu chayyav. vechen hammashve pene hassade kegon shehishpil hattel veriddedo o mille haggay chayyav mishshum choresh. veshiuro kol shehu. vechen kol hammashve gummot shiuro kol shehu: 
Hazzorea kol shehu chayyav. hazzomer et hailan kede sheyyitzmach hare ze meen zorea. aval hammashke tzemachin veilanot beshabbat hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu. vechen hashshore chittin useorin vechayyotze bahen bammayim hare ze toledet zorea vechayyav bechol shehu: 
Hakkotzer kigrogeret chayyav. vetolesh toledet kotzer hu. vechol haoker davar miggiddulo chayyav mishshum kotzer. lefichach tzeror shealu bo asavim ucheshut sheala bassene vaasavim shetztzamchu al gav hechavit. hattolesh mehen chayyav shezze hu mekom giddulan. aval hattolesh meatzitz sheeno nakuv patur mippene sheen ze mekom giddulo. veatzitz nakuv bichde shoresh katan hare hu keeretz vehattolesh mimmennu chayyav: 
Kol zera shekketzirato matzmachat oto umegaddalto kegon aspasta vesilka. hakkotzro bishgaga chayyav shete chattaot. achat mippene shehu kotzer veachat mippene shehu notea. vechen hazzomer vehu tzarich laetzim chayyav mishshum kotzer umishshum notea. gavshushit shel afar shealu bah asavim, higbihah meal haaretz vehinnichah al gabbe yetedot chayyav mishshum tolesh. hayta al gabbe yetedot vehinnichah al haaretz chayyav mishshum zorea. teenim sheyyavshu beibbehen vechen ilan sheyyavshu perotav bo. hattolesh mehen beshabbat chayyav af al pi shehen kaakurin leinyan tuma: 
Hattolesh ulshin hamezared zeradin. im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. hameammer ochalin im laachila shiuro kigrogeret. veim immer livhema shiuro kimlo pi gedi. veim lehassaka shiuro kede levashshel betza. uvetza haamura bechol makom hi betza benonit shel tarnegolin. vechol makom shenneemar kede levashshel betza hu kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza ugerogeret echad mishshelosha bevetza. veen immur ella begiddule karka: 
Hamekabbetz devela veasa mimmenna iggula o shennikkev teenim vehichnis hachevel bahen ad shennitkabbetzu guf echad. hare ze toledet meammer vechayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haddash kigrogeret chayyav veen disha ella begiddule karka. vehamefarek hare hi toledet haddash vechayyav vechen kol kayyotze baze. hacholev et habbehema chayyav mishshum mefarek vechen hachovel bechay sheyyesh lo or chayyav mishshum mefarek. vehu sheyyihye tzarich laddam sheyyetze min hachabbura. aval im nitkavven lehazzik bilvad patur mippene shehu mekalkel. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye baddam o bachalav shehotzi kigrogeret: 
Bamme devarim amurim bechovel bivhema vechayya veof vechayyotze bahem. aval hachovel bachavero af al pi shennitkavven lehazzik chayyav mippene nachat rucho shehare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato vahare hu kimtakken. veaf al pi sheeno tzarich laddam shehotzi mimmennu chayyav: 
Shemona sheratzim haamurim battora hen sheyyesh lahen orot leinyan shabbat kemo chayya uvehema veof. aval shear shekatzim uremasim en lahen or. lefichach hachovel bahen patur. veechad hachovel bivhema chayya veof o bishmona sheratzim veasa bahen chabbura veyatza mehem dam o shennitzrar haddam af al pi shello yatza chayyav: 
Hassochet et happerot lehotzi memehen chayyav mishshum mefarek. veeno chayyav ad sheyyihye bammashkin shessachat kigrogeret. veen chayyavim min hattora ella al derichat zetim vaanavim bilvad. umuttar lischot eshkol shel anavim letoch haochel. shemmashke habba leochel ochel hu venimtza kimfarek ochel meochel. aval im sachat lichli sheen bo ochel hare ze dorech vechayyav. vehacholev letoch haochel o hayyonek befiv patur veeno chayyav ad sheyyachalov letoch hakkeli: 
Hazzore o habborer kigrogeret chayyav. vehamechabbetz hare hu toledet borer. vechen habborer shemarim mittoch hammashkin hare ze toledet borer o toledet merakked vechayyav. shehazzore vehabborer vehamerakked domin inyenehem ze laze. umippene ma manu otan bishlosha mippene shekkol melacha shehayta bammishkan monin otah bifne atzmah: 
Habborer ochel mittoch pesolet o shehayu lefanav shene mine ochalin uverer min mimmin acher benafa uvichvara chayyav. bekanon o betamchuy patur. veim berer beyado leechol lealtar muttar: 
Vehabborer pesolet mittoch haochel vaafillu beyado achat chayyav. vehabborer turmosin mittoch pesolet shellahen chayyav mippene shehappesolet shellahen mematteket otan kesheyyishleku otan immahem venimtza kevorer pesolet mittoch ochel vechayyav. habborer ochel mittoch pesolet beyado lehannicho afillu levo bayyom naasa kevorer laotzar vechayyav. hayu lefanav shene mine ochalin meoravin borer echad meacher umanniach leechol miyyad. veim berer vehinniach leachar zeman afillu levo bayyom kegon shebberer beshacharit leechol ben haarbayim chayyav: 
Hmshammer yayin o shemen o mayim vechen shear hammashkin bammeshammeret shellahen chayyav. vehu sheyyeshammer kigrogeret. aval mesannenin yayin sheen bo shemarim o mayim tzelulin besudarin uvichfifa mitzrit kede sheyyehe tzalul beyoter. venotnin mayim al gabbe shemarim bishvil sheyyitztzolu. venotnin betza terufa limsannenet shel chardal kede sheyyitztzalel. chardal shellasho meerev shabbat. lemachar memache veshote ben bayyad ben bichli. vechen yayin miggitto kol zeman shehu toses toref chavit bishmareha venoten letoch hassudarin. sheadayin lo nifreshu hashshemarim min hayyayin yafe yafe vechol hayyayin keguf echad hu. vechen hachardal vechol kayyotze bo: 
Hattochen kigrogeret chayyav. vechol hashshochek tavlin vesammanin bemachteshet hare ze tochen vechayyav. hamechattech yarak talush hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hannoser etzim lehanot binsoret shellahen o hashshaf lashon shel mattechet chayyav mishsheyyashuf kol shehu. aval hamechattech etzim eno chayyav ad sheyyedakdek mehen kede levashshel kigrogeret mibbetza: 
Hamerakked kigrogeret chayyav. hallash kigrogeret chayyav hamegabbel et heafar hare ze toledet lash. vechamma shiuro kede laasot pi kur shel tzorfe zahav. veen gibbul beefer velo bechol haggas velo bemursan velo bechayyotze bahen. vehannoten zera shumshemin o zera pishtan vechayyotze bahen bemayim chayyav mishshum lash. mippene shehen mitarvin venitlin ze baze:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 9:
Haofe kigrogeret chayyav. echad haofe et happat o hamevashshel et hammaachol o et hassammanin o hamechammem et hammayim hakkol inyan echad hu. shiur hamechammem et hammayim kede lirchotz bahen evar katan. veshiur mevashshel sammanin kede sheyyihyu reuyin ledavar shemmevashshelin otan lo: 
Hannoten betza betzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel venitgalgela chayyav. shehamevashshel betoledet haur kimvashshel baur atzmah. vechen hammediach bechammin dag maliach hayyashan o kuleyays haispanin vehu dag dak verach beyoter hare ze chayyav. shehadachatan bechammin ze hu gemar bishshulan. vechen kol kayyotze bahen: 
Hammafkia et habbetza beveged cham o bechol uvaavak derachim shehen chammim mippene hashshemesh af al pi shennitzlet patur. shettoldot chamma enam ketoldot haesh. aval gazru alehen mippene toldot haur. vechen hamevashshel bechamme teverya vechayyotze bahem patur. hamevashshel al haur davar shehaya mevushshal kol tzarko o davar sheeno tzarich bishshul kelal patur: 
Echad natan et haur veechad natan et haetzim veechad natan et hakkedera veechad natan et hammayim veechad natan et habbasar veechad natan et hattavlin uva acher vehegis kullam chayyavim mishshum mevashshel. shekkol haose davar mitztzarche habbishshul hare ze mevashshel. aval im shafat echad et hakkedera techilla uva acher venatan et hammayim uva acher venatan et habbasar uva acher venatan et hattavlin uva acher venatan et haur uva acher venatan etzim al haur uva acher vehegis. shenayim haacharonim bilvad chayyavin mishshum mevashshel: 
Hinniach basar al gabbe gechalim im nitzla bo kigrogeret afillu bishnayim ushelosha mekomot chayyav. lo nitzla bo kigrogeret aval nitbashshel kullo chatzi bishshul chayyav. nitbashshel chatzi bishshul mitztzad echad patur. ad sheyyahafoch bo veyitbashshel chatzi bishshul mishshene tzedadin. shachach vehidbik pat battannur beshabbat venizkar muttar lo lirdota kodem shetteafe veyavo lide melacha: 
Hammattich echad mimmine mattachot kol shehu o hamechammem et hammattachot ad shettease gachelet hare ze toledet mevashshel. vechen hamemasses et haddonag o et hachelev o et hazzefet vehakkofer vehaggafrit vechayyotze bahem hare ze toledet mevashshel vechayyav. vechen hamevashshel kele adama ad sheyyeasu cheres chayyav mishshum mevashshel. kelalo shel davar ben sherippa guf kashe baesh o shehiksha guf rach hare ze chayyav mishshum mevashshel: 
Haggozez tzemer o sear ben min habbehema ben min hachayya ben min hachay ben min hammet afillu min hashshelach shellahen chayyav. kamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut shearko kerochav hassit kaful. vechamma rochav hassit kede limtoach min bohen shel yad ad haetzba harishona kesheyyiftach benehen bechol kocho vehu karov lishne shelishe zeret. hattolesh kanaf min haof hare ze toledet gozez. hattove et hatztzemer min hachay patur sheen derech geziza bechach veen derech nipputz bechach veen derech teviyya bechach: 
Hannotel tzipparnav o searo o sefamo o zekano hare ze toledet gozez vechayyav. vehu sheyyittol bichli. aval im netalan beyado ben lo ben leacher patur. vechen hachotech yabbelet miggufo ben beyad ben bichli patur ben lo ben leacher. umuttar lachtoch yabbelet bammikdash beyad aval lo bichli. veim hayta yevesha chotchah af bichli veoved avoda: 
Hannotel searo bichli kamma yittol veyihye chayyav. shete searot. veim likket levanot mittoch shechorot afillu achat chayyav. tzipporen sheppersha rubbah vetzitzin shel or sheppershu rubban im pershu kelappe mala umetzaarot oto muttar littol otan beyado aval lo bichli. veim netalan bichli patur. veim enan metzaarot oto afillu bayyad asur. veim lo pershu rubban afillu metzaarot oto asur lenatlan beyado veim netalan bichli chayyav: 
Hamelabben et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani. vechen kol kayyotze bahen mimma sheddarkan lehitlabben chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko kimlo rochav hassit kaful shehu orech arbaa tefachim: 
Hamechabbes begadim hare hu toledet melabben vechayyav. vhassochet et habbeged ad sheyyotzi hammayim shebbo hare ze mechabbes vechayyav. shehassechita mitztzarche kibbus hi kemo shehahagasa mitztzarche habbishshul. veen sechita besear vehu haddin leor sheen chayyavin al sechitato: 
Hamenappetz et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hashshani vechayyotze bahen chayyav. vechamma shiuro kede litvot mimmennu chut echad arko arbaa tefachim. vehamenappetz et haggidim ad sheyyeasu ketzemer kede litvot otan hare ze toledet menappetz vechayyav: 
Hatztzovea chut shearko arbaa tefachim o davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut kaze chayyav. veen hatztzovea chayyav ad sheyyehe tzeva hammitkayyem. aval tzeva sheeno mitkayyem kelal kegon sheheevir sarak o shashar al gabbe barzel o nechoshet utzevao patur. shehare atta maaviro lishato veeno tzovea kelum. vechol sheen melachto mitkayyemet beshabbat patur: 
Haose en hatztzeva hare ze toledet tzovea vechayyav. ketzad. kegon shennatan kankantom letoch me appetza shennaasa hakkol shachor. o shennatan istis letoch me karkom shennaasa hakkol yarok. vechen kol kayyotze baze. vechamma shiuro kede litzboa bo chut shearko arbaa tefachim: 
Hattove orech arbaa tefachim mikkol davar hannitve chayyav. echad hattove et hatztzemer o et happishtan o et hannotza o et hassear o et haggidin. vechen kol kayyotze bahen. haose et halleved hare ze toledet tove vechayyav. vehu sheyyelabbed davar sheefshar litvot mimmennu chut orech arbaa tefachim beovi benoni: 
Haose shene batte nirin chayyav. haose nafa o kevara o sal o sevacha o shessarag mitta bachavalim hare ze toledet ose nirin umishsheyyaase shene battim beechad mikkol ellu chayyav. vechen kol haose shene batte nirin bedavar sheosin oto battim battim kegon ellu chayyav: 
Derech haorgin shemmotchin hachutin techilla beorech hayeria uverachbah ushenayim ochazin ze mikkan veze mikkan veechad shovet beshevet al hachutin umetakken otan ze betzad ze ad shettease kullah sheti belo erev. umetichat hachutin kederech haorgin hi hanesachat hammassechet veze hammoteach nikra mesech. ucheshekkoflin otah umatchil lehachenis hashsheti baerev nikra oreg: 
Hammesech chayyav vehi melacha meavot melachot. vehashshovet al hachutin ad sheyyipparku vitakkenem hare ze toledet mesech. vechamma shiuro mishsheyyetakken rochav shete etzbaot. vechen haoreg shene chutin berochav shete etzbaot chayyav. ben shearagan battechilla ben shehaya miktzat habbeged arug vearag al haarug shiuro shene chutin. veim arag chut echad vehishlim bo habbeged chayyav. arag bisfat hayeria shene chutin berochav shelosha batte nirin chayyav. ha lema ze dome leoreg tziltzul katan berochav shelosha batte nirin: 
Hamedakdek et hachutin umafridan beet haariga hare ze toledet oreg. vechen hakkolea et hannimin hare ze toledet oreg veshiuro mishsheyyaase kelia beorech shete etzbaot: 
Habbotzea shene chutin chayyav. uvotzea hu hammafrish et haarug. ben shehotzi haerev min hashsheti o sheheevir hashsheti meal haerev hare ze botzea vechayyav. vehu shello yehe mekalkel ella yitkavven letakken kederech sheosin ellu shemmeachin et habbegadim hakkallim beyoter shebbotzin veachar kach meachin vechozrin veorgin chutin shebbatzu ad sheyyeasu shene habbegadim o shene hakkeraim echad. vehassoter et hakkelia letakken hare ze toledet botzea veshiuro keshiur habbotzea:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 10:
Hakosher kesher shel kayyama vehu maase umman chayyav. kegon kesher haggammalin vekesher hassappanin vekishre retzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin haratzanin bishat asiyyatan. vechen kol kayyotze baze. aval hakkosher kesher shel kayyama veeno maase umman patur. vekesher sheeno shel kayyama veeno maase umman muttar lekashro lechattechilla: 
Ketzad. nifseka lo retzua ukesharah, nifsak hachevel ukesharo, o shekkashar chevel bidli o shekkashar resen behema hare ze patur. vechen kol kayyotze beellu hakkesharim shehen maase hedyot vechol adam kosher otan lekayyama. vechol kesher sheeno shel kayyama im kesharo kesher umman hare ze asur: 
Kosheret ishsha mifteche hechaluk af al pi sheyyesh lo shene petachim, vechute sevacha af al pi shehu rafuy beroshah, uretzuot minal vesandal shekkoshrin otan al haregel bishat malbush, venodot yayin veshemen af al pi sheyyesh lo shete aznayim, ukedera shel basar af al pi sheyyechola lehotzi habbasar velo tattir hakkesher. vekoshrin deli bimshicha o beavnet vechayyotze bo aval lo bechevel. vekoshrin lifne habbehema o beraglah bishvil shello tetze af al pi sheyyesh lah shene issarot. vechevel shehaya kashur bappara koshro baevus. haya kashur baevus koshro bappara. aval lo yavi chevel mittoch beto veyikshor bappara uvaevus. veim haya chevel gardi shemmuttar letaltelo hare ze mevi vekosher bappara uvaevus. mippene shekkol ellu hakkesharim maase hedyot hen veenan shel kayyama ella paam kosher ufaam mattir ulefichach muttar likshor otan lechattechilla. chotalot shel temarim veshel gerogarot mattir umafkia vechotech venotel veochel: 
Kol sherauy lemaachal behema muttar likshor oto beshabbat. lefichach im nifseka retzuat sandalo becharmelit notel gemi lach harauy lemaachal behema vechorech alav vekosher haggemi. nishmeta lo retzuat minal vesandal o shennishmat rov haregel muttar lehachazir hartzuot limkoman uvilvad shello yikshor: 
Haaniva mutteret lefi sheenah mitchallefet bikshira. lefichach hachevel shennifsak mekabbetz shene ketzotav vechorech alav meshicha veonev aniva: 
Muttar likshor kesher sheeno shel kayyama lidvar mitzva. kegon sheyyikshor limdod shiur mishshiure hattora. nimat kinnor shennifsak koshrin otah bammikdash aval lo bammedina. velo yikshor nima lechattechilla afillu bammikdash: 
Kol kesher shechayyavin al kishshuro kach chayyavin al hettero. vechol kesher shehakkosher oto patur kach hammattir oto patur. vechol kesher shemmuttar lekashro kach muttar lehattiro: 
Happotel chavalim min hahutzin umin hachelef o michute tzemer o michute pishtan o chute sear vechayyotze bahen hare ze toledet kosher vechayyav. veshiuro kede sheyyaamod hachevel biftilato belo keshira shennimtzet melachto mitkayyemet. vechen hammafrid et happetil hare ze toledet mattir vechayyav. vehu shello yitkavven lekalkel bilvad. veshiuro keshiur happotel: 
Hattofer shete tefirot chayyav. vehu shekkashar rashe hachut mikkan umikkan kede shettaamod hattefira velo tishshamet. aval im tafar yeter al shete tefirot af al pi shello kashar chayyav shehare mitkayyemet hattefira. vehammoteach chut shel tefira beshabbat chayyav mippene shehu mitztzarche hattefira: 
Hakkorea kede litpor shete tefirot al menat litpor shete tefirot chayyav. aval hakkorea lehafesidah patur mippene shehu mekalkel. hakkorea bachamato o al met shehu chayyav likroa alav chayyav mippene shemmeyashshev et dato bedavar ze veyanuach yitzro vehoil vachamato shochechet bedavar ze hare hu kimtakken vechayyav. vehappoteach bet hatztzavvar beshabbat chayyav: 
Hamedabbek neyarot o orot bekolan shel sofrim vechayyotze bo hare ze toledet tofer vechayyav. vechen hamefarek neyarot devukin o orot devukin velo nitkavven lekalkel bilvad hare ze toledet korea vechayyav: 
Habbone kol shehu chayyav. hammashve pene hakkarka bevayit kegon shehishpil tel o mille guma o gay hare ze bone vechayyav. echad natan et haeven veechad natan et hattit hannoten hattit chayyav. uvannidbach haelyon afillu heela et haeven vehinnichah al gabbe hattit chayyav. shehare en mannichin aleha tit acher. vehabbone al gabbe kelim patur: 
Haose ohel kavua hare ze toledet bone vechayyav. vechen haose kele adama kegon tannur vechavit kodem sheyyissarfu hare ze toledet bone vechayyav. vechen hamegabben et haggevina hare ze toledet bone. veeno chayyav ad sheyyegabben kigrogeret. hammachnis yad hakkardom betoch haetz shello hare ze toledet bone. vechen kol kayyotze bo. vechen hattokea etz beetz ben shettaka bemasmer ben shettaka baetz atzmo ad shennitached hare ze toledet bone vechayyav: 
Haose nekev kol shehu belul shel tarnegolim kede sheyyikkanes lahen haora chayyav mishshum bone. hammachazir delet shel bor veshel dut veshel yatzia chayyav mishshum bone: 
Hassoter kol shehu chayyav. vehu sheyyistor al menat livnot. aval im satar derech hashechata patur. hassoter ohel kavua o shepperek etz takua hare ze toledet soter vechayyav vehu sheyyitkavven letakken: 
Hammakke befattish hakkaa achat chayyav. vechol haose davar shehu gemar melacha hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav. ketzad. hamenappeach bichle zechuchit vehatztzar bakkeli tzura afillu miktzat hatztzura vehamegared kol shehu vehaose nekev kol shehu ben beetz ben bemattechet ben bevinyan ben bechelim hare ze toledet makke befattish vechayyav. vechol petach sheeno asuy lehachenis ulehotzi en chayyavin al asiyyato: 
Hammefis shechin beshabbat kede leharechiv pi hammakka kederech sheharofin osin shehen mitkavvenin birfua leharechiv pi hammakka hare ze chayyav mishshum makke befattish shezzo hi melechet harofe. veim hefisa lehotzi mimmenna hallecha shebbah hare ze muttar: 
Hamesattet et haeven kol shehu chayyav mishshum makke befattish. hametzadded et haeven bisod habbinyan vetikkenah beyado vehoshivah bammakom harauy lah chayyav mishshum makke befattish. halloket yabbolet sheal gabbe begadim beyado kegon ellu hayyabbolot shebbichle tzemer chayyav mishshum makke befattish. vehu sheyyakpid alehen. aval im hesiran derech esek hare ze patur. hamenaer tallit chadasha shechora kede lenaotah ulehasir hatztzemer hallavan hannitle bah kederech shehaummanin osin chayyav chattat. veim eno makpid muttar: 
Hatztzad davar shedderech mino latzud oto chayyav. kegon chayya veofot vedagim. vehu sheyyatzud otan lemakom sheeno mechussar tzeda. ketzad. kegon sheradaf achare tzevi ad shehichniso levayit o leginna o lechatzer venaal befanav. o shehifriach et haof ad shehichniso lemigdal venaal befanav. o sheshshala dagim min hayyam betoch sefel shel mayim hare ze chayyav. aval im hifriach tzippor levayit venaal befanav. o shehivriach dag vaakaro min hayyam livrecha shel mayim. o sheradaf achar tzevi ad shennichnas litraklin rachav venaal befanav hare ze patur. sheen zo tzida gemura sheim yavo lekachto tzarich lirdof acharav velatzud oto mishsham. lefichach hatztzad ari eno chayyav ad sheyyachnisennu lakkippa shello shehu neesar bah: 
Kol makom sheim yarutz bo yaggia lachayya bishchiyya achat. o shehayu hakketalim kerovin ze laze ad sheyyippol tzel shenehem laemtza keechad hare ze makom katan. veim hivriach hatztzevi vechayyotze bo letocho chayyav. umakom shehu gadol mizze hammavriach chayya vaof letocho patur: 
Echad shemona sheratzim haamurin battora veechad shear shekatzim uremasim sheyyesh leminan tzida hatztzad echad mikkullan ben letzorech ben shello letzorech o lesachek bahen chayyav hoil venitkavven latzud vetzad. shemmelacha sheenah tzericha legufah chayyav aleha. hatztzad et hayyashen veet hassuma chayyav: 
Hameshalleach kelavim kede sheyyatzudu tzevaim vearnavim vechayyotze bahen uvarach hatztzevi mippene hakkelev vehaya hu rodef achar hatztzevi o sheamad befanav vehivhilo ad shehiggia hakkelev utefaso hare ze toledet hatztzad vechayyav. vechen haose kadderech hazzo beofot: 
Tzevi shennichnas levayit venaal echad befanav chayyav. nealuhu shenayim peturin. im en echad yachol linol unealuhu shenayim chayyavin. yashav echad al happetach velo milleahu veyashav hashsheni umilleahu hashsheni chayyav. yashav harishon umilleahu uva hashsheni veyashav betziddo af al pi sheamad harishon vehalach lo harishon chayyav vehashsheni lo asa kelum umuttar lo leshev bimkomo ad haerev velokeach hatztzevi. lema ze dome lenoel beto leshamro venimtza tzevi shamur betocho shello asa kelum. nichnesa lo tzippor tachat kenafav yoshev umeshammerah ad shettechshach umuttar: 
Hatztzad tzevi zaken o chigger o chole o katan patur. hamefarek behema chayya vaof min hammetzuda patur. hatztzad chayya vaof shebbirshuto kegon avazin vetarnegolin veyone (aliyya) patur. hatztzad davar sheen bemino tzida kegon chagavim haggazin tzerain veyattushin ufaroshin vechayyotze baellu hare ze patur: 
Remasim hammazzikin kegon nechashim veakrabbim vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheenan memitin hoil venoshchin muttar latzud otam beshabbat. vehu sheyyitkavven lehinnatzel minneshichatan. ketzad hu ose. kofe keli alehen o makkif alehen o koshran kede shello yazziku:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 11:
Hashochet chayyav. velo shochit bilvad ella kol hannotel neshama leechad mikkol mine chayya uvehema veof vedag vesheretz ben bishchita o binchira o behakkaa chayyav. hachonek et hachay ad sheyyamut hare ze toledet shochet. lefichach im heela dag missefel shel mayim vehinnicho ad shemmet chayyav mishshum chonek. velo ad sheyyamut ella kevan sheyyavesh bo kesela ben senappirav chayyav sheod eno yachol lichyot. hoshit yado lime habbehema vedildel ebbar shebbemeeha chayyav: 
Remasim shehen parin veravin mizzachar unekeva o nehevin min heafar kemo happaroshin hahoreg otan chayyav kehoreg behema vechayya. aval remasim shehavayatan min haggelalim umin happerot shehivishu vechayyotze bahen kegon tolaim shel basar vetolaim shebbetoch hakkitniyyot hahorgan patur: 
Hamefalle kelav beshabbat molel et hakkinnim vezorkan. umuttar laharog et hakkinnim beshabbat mippene shehen min hazzea: 
Chayya veremes shehen noshchin umemitin vadday kegon zevuv shebbemitzrayim vetzira shebbeninve veakrav shebbachadayev venachash shebbeeretz yisrael vechelev shote bechol makom muttar lehargan beshabbat kesheyyerau. ushear kol hammazzikin im hayu ratzin acharav muttar lehargan veim hayu yoshvin bimkoman o borchin millefanav asur lehargan. veim dorsan lefi tummo bishat hillucho vehorgan muttar: 
Hammafshit min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav. vechen hameabbed min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav. veechad hammoleach veechad hameabbed shehammelicha min ibbud hu veen ibbud boochalin. vechen hammochek min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav. vee zehu mochek ze hammaavir sear o hatztzemer meal haor achar mita ad sheyyachalik pene haor: 
Hamefarek duchesusetus meal hakkelaf hare ze toledet mafshit vechayyav. (hamefarek min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav). haddores al haor beraglo ad sheyyitkashshe o hamerakkecho beyado umoshcho umashve oto kederech sheharatzanin osin hare ze toledet meabbed vechayyav. hammoret notza min haevra hare ze toledet mochek vechayyav. vechen hamemareach retiyya kol shehu o shaava o zefet vechayyotze bahen middevarim hammitmarchin ad sheyyachalik penehem chayyav mishshum mochek. vechen hashshaf beyado al haor hammatuach ben haammudim chayyav mishshum mochek: 
Hamechattech min haor kede laasot kamea chayyav. vehu sheyyitkavven lemiddat arko umiddat rachbo veyachtoch bechavvana shehi melacha. aval im chatach derech hefsed o belo kavvana lemiddato ella kemitassek o kimsachek hare ze patur. hakkotem et hakkanaf hare ze toledet mechattech vechayyav. vechen hamegared rashe kelunesot shel erez chayyav mishshum mechattech. vechen kol chaticha sheyyachtoch charash etz min haetzim o charash mattechet min hammattachot chayyav mishshum mechattech. hannotel kesam shel etz millefanav uketamo lachtzotz bo shinnav o liftoach bo et haddelet chayyav: 
Kol davar shehu rauy lemaachal behema kegon teven vaasavim lachim vehutzin vechayyotze bahen muttar liktom otan beshabbat mippene sheen bahen tikkun kelim. umuttar liktom atze besamim lehariach bahen af al pi shehen kashim viveshin. umefashsheach mehen kol ma sheyyirtze ben sheppashach etz gadol ben sheppashach etz katan: 
Hakkotev shete otiyyot chayyav. hammochek ketav al menat lichtov bimkom hammachak shete otiyyot chayyav. hkotev ot achat gedola kishtayim patur. machak ot achat gedola veyesh bimkomah kede lichtov shetayim chayyav. katav ot achat vehishlim bah et hassefer chayyav. hakkotev al menat lekalkel haor chayyav sheen chiyyuvo al mekom hakketav ella al hakketav. aval hammochek al menat lekalkel patur. nafla deyo al gabbe sefer umachak otah. nafla shaava al gabbe happinkas umachak otah. im yesh bimkomah kede lichtov shete otiyyot chayyav: 
Hakkotev ot kefula paamayim vehu shem echad kemo dad tet gag rar sas sas chach chayyav. vehakkotev bechol ketav uvechol lashon chayyav vaafillu mishshene simaniyyot: 
Hakkotev ot achat samuch lakketav o ketav al gabbe ketav vehammitkavven lichtov chet vechatav shene zayinnin vechen kayyotze baze bishar otiyyot vehakkotev ot achat baaretz veot achat bakkora shehare en nehegin ze im ze o shekkatav shete otiyyot bishne dappe pinkas veenan nehegin ze im ze patur. ketavan bishne katle zavit o bishne dappe pinkas vehen nehegin ze im ze chayyav: 
Lakach gevil vechayyotze bo vechatav alav ot achat bimdina zo vehalach beoto hayyom vechatav ot sheniyya bimdina acheret bimgilla acheret chayyav. shebbizman shemmekarvan nehegin ze im ze veenan mechussarin maase likrivatan: 
Hakkotev ot achat af al pi shekkorim mimmenna teva shelema patur. ketzad. kegon shekkatav 40 vehakkol korin otah maaser. o shekketavah bemakom minyan shehare hi kemo shekkatav arbaim hare ze patur. hammaggiah ot achat veasa otah shetayim kegon shechillek gag hachet venaaset shene zayinnin chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Hakkotev bismolo o leachar yado beraglo befiv uvemarpeko patur. itter shekkatav bimino shehi lo kismol kol adam patur. veim katav bismolo chayyav. vehashsholet bishte yadav beshave vechatav ben bimino ben bismolo chayyav. katan ochez bekulmos vegadol ochez beyado vechotev chayyav. gadol ochez bekulmos vekatan ochez beyado vechotev patur: 
En hakkotev chayyav ad sheyyichtov bedavar haroshem veomed kegon deyo veshachor vesikra vekomos vekankantom vechayyotze bahem. veyichtov al davar shemmitkayyem hakketav alav kegon or ukelaf uneyar veetz vechayyotze bahem. aval hakkotev bedavar sheen rishshumo omed kegon mashkin ume perot. o shekkatav bidyo vechayyotze bo al ale yerakot veal kol davar sheeno omed patur. eno chayyav ad sheyyichtov bedavar haomed al davar haomed. vechen en hammochek chayyav ad sheyyimchok ketav haomed meal davar haomed: 
Hakkotev al besaro chayyav mippene shehu or af al pi shechamimut besaro maaveret hakketav leachar zeman hare ze dome lichtav shennimchak. aval hamesaret al besaro tzurat ketav patur. hakkorea al haor ketavnit ketav chayyav mishshum kotev. haroshem al haor ketavnit ketav patur. hammaavir deyo al gabbe sikra chayyav shetayim achat mishshum kotev veachat mishshum mochek. heevir deyo al gabbe deyo vesikra al gabbe sikra o sikra al gabbe deyo patur: 
Roshem toledet kotev hu. ketzad. haroshem reshamim vetzurot bechotel uveshashar vechayyotze bahen kederech shehatztzayyarin roshmim hare ze chayyav mishshum kotev. vechen hammochek et harishshum letakken hare ze toledet mochek vechayyav. hamesartet kede lichtov shete otiyyot tachat oto sirtut chayyav. charashe haetzim shemmaavirin chut shel sikra al gabbe hakkora kede sheyyinsor beshave hare ze toledet mesartet. vechen haggabbalim sheosim ken baavanim kede sheyyefatztzel haeven beshave. veechad hamesartet betzeva o belo tzeva hare ze chayyav:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 12:
Hammavir kol shehu chayyav. vehu sheyyehe tzarich laefer. aval im hivir derech hashechata patur mippene shehu mekalkel. vehammavir gedisho shel chavero o hassoref dirato chayyav af al pi shehu mashchit. mippene shekkavvanato lehinnakem missono vahare nitkarra dato veshachcha chamato venaasa kekorea al meto o bachamato shehu chayyav uvechovel bachavero bishat meriva shekkol ellu metakkenim hen etzel yitzran hara. vechen hammadlik et hanner o et haetzim ben lehitchammem ben lehair hare ze chayyav. hamechammem et habbarzel kede letzarfo bemayim hare ze toledet mavir vechayyav: 
Hamechabbe kol shehu chayyav. echad hamechabbe et hanner veechad hamechabbe et haggachelet shel etz. aval hamechabbe gachelet shel mattechet patur. veim nitkavven letzaref chayyav. shekken lotshe habbarzel osim mechimmim et habbarzel ad sheyyease gachelet umechabbin oto bemayim kede lechassemo. vezehu letzaref shehaose oto chayyav vehu toledet mechabbe. umuttar lechabbot gachelet shel mattechet birshut harabbim kede shello yizzoku bah rabbim. hannoten shemen letoch hanner haddolek chayyav mishshum mavir. vehammistappek min hashshemen shebbanner chayyav mishshum mechabbe: 
Deleka shennafla beshabbat hamechabbe otah mippene ibbud mamon chayyav sheen ibbud mamon doche shabbat ella ibbud nefashot. lefichach yetzu bene adam kede shello yamutu veyannichu haesh telahet vaafillu sorefet kol dirato kullah: 
Muttar laasot mechitztza bechol hakkelim ben meleim ben rekanim kede shello taavor haddeleka. afillu keli cheres chadashim meleim mayim osin mehen mechitztza af al pi shevvadday mitbakkein umechabbim. sheggeram kibbuy muttar. vechofin keara al gabbe hanner bishvil shello teachez bakkora: 
Teva shidda umigdal sheachaz bahen haur mevi or gedi vechayyotze bo middevarim sheen haur melahetet otan uforso al hakkatze sheadayin lo nisraf kede shello taavor sham haesh: 
Tallit sheachaz bah haur poshtah umitkasse bah veim kavta kavta. vechen sefer tora sheachaz bo haur poshto vekore bo veim kava kava. venoten mayim min hatztzad sheadayin lo nitla bo haur veim kavta kavta. shachach ner daluk al gabbe tavla menaer et hattavla vehu nofel veim kava kava. aval hinnicho mibbaerev af al pi shekkava asur letaltelo: 
Nachri shebba lechabbot en omrim lo kabbe veal techabbe mippene sheen shevitato alenu. aval katan shebba lechabbot en shomin lo. vehu sheyyihye ose al daat aviv. aval middaat atzmo en bet din metzuvvin lehaferisho. uvidleka hittiru lomar kol hamechabbe eno mafsid: 
Hotzaa vehachenasa mershut lirshut melacha meavot melachot hi. veaf al pi sheddavar ze im kol gufe tora mippi moshe missinay neemru. hare hu omer battora <small>(Shemot 36 6)</small> "ish veishsha al yaasu od melacha litrumat hakkodesh vayyikkale haam mehavi". ha lamadta shehahavaa melacha kore otah. vechen lamdu mippi hashshemua shehammaavir birshut harabbim mittechillat arba lesof arba hare hu kemotzi mershut lirshut vechayyav: 
En hammotzi mershut lirshut chayyav ad sheyyotzi kashshiur hammoil. mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid. veyaakor mershut zo veyanniach birshut sheniyya. aval im akar velo hinniach o hinniach velo akar o shehotzi pachot mikkashshiur patur. vechen hammaavir mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim eno chayyav ad sheyyaakor kashshiur mitztzad ze veyannichennu mitztzad acheret: 
Hazzorek mershut lirshut o hammoshit hare ze toledet motzi vechayyav. vechen hazzorek o hammoshit beyado mittechillat arba lesof arba hare ze toledet motzi vechayyav. vehazzorek kilachar yad patur: 
Hammotzi miktzat hachefetz mershut mishshete reshuyot ellu lirshut sheniyya patur. ad sheyyotzi et kol hachefetz kullo mershut zo lirshut zo. kuppa shehi melea chafatzim afillu melea chardal vehotzi rubbah mershut zo lirshut zo patur ad sheyyotzi et kol hakkuppa vechen kol haddome laze shehakkeli mesim kol sheyyesh bo kechefetz echad: 
Hammotzi ben bimino ben bismolo ben betoch cheko o sheyyatza bemaot tzerurin lo bisdino chayyav mippene shehotzi kederech hammotziin. vechen hammotzi al ketefo chayyav af al pi shehammassooy lemala measara tefachim birshut harabbim. shekken haya massa bene kehat bammishkan lemala measara shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 7 9)</small> "bakkatef yissau". vechol hammelachot mimmishkan lomdin otan: 
Aval hammotzi leachar yado beraglo befiv uvemarpeko beazno uvisaro uvechis shettafur bevigdo ufi hakkis lematta ben beged leveged, befi bigdo beminalo uvesandalo patur shello hotzi kederech hammotziin: 
Hammotzi massooy al rosho. im haya massooy kaved kegon sak male o teva umigdal vechayyotze bahen shehu mesim al rosho vetofes beyado chayyav. shekken derech hammotziin venimtza kemotzi al ketefo o beyado. aval im lakach chefetz kal kegon shehinniach beged o sefer o sakkin al rosho vehotzio vehu eno ochez beyado hare ze patur shello hotzi kederech hammotziin. sheen derech rov haolam lehotzi hachafatzin munnachin al rashehem. hammaavir chefetz mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim af al pi sheheeviro lemala merosho chayyav: 
Muttar leadam letaltel birshut harabbim betoch arba ammot al arba ammot shehu omed betziddan. veyesh lo letaltel bechol hamerubba hazze. uveamma shello moddin. veim haya nannas beevarav notnin lo arba ammot kevenoniyyot shel kol adam. umippi hakkabbala amru shezze shenneemar battora <small>(Shemot 16 29)</small> "shevu ish tachtav" shello yetaltel chutz limrubba ze ella bimrubba ze shehu kemiddat orech adam kesheyyifshot yadav veraglav bo bilvad yesh letaltel: 
Hayu shenayim miktzat arba ammot shel ze letoch arba ammot shel ze meviin veochlin baemtza. uvilvad shello yotzi ze mittoch shello letoch shel chavero. veim hayu shelosha vehaemtzai muvla bentayim. hu muttar immahen vehen muttarin immo ushenayim hachitzonim asurim ze im ze: 
Lefichach muttar leadam laakor chefetz mershut harabbim velitteno lachavero sheimmo betoch arba ammot. vechen chavero lachavero haacher shebbetziddo afillu hen mea. veaf al pi shehachefetz holech kamma milin beshabbat muttar. mippene shekkol echad mehen lo tiltel ella betoch arba ammot shello: 
Hoil veyesh lo leadam letaltel bechol hamerubba shehu arba ammot al arba ammot nimtza metaltel beorech alachsono shel merubba ze chamesh ammot ushelosha chumshe amma. lefichach en hammaavir o hazzorek birshut harabbim chayyav ad sheyyaavir chutz lechamesh ammot ushelosha chumshe amma. vechol makom sheamarnu mittechillat arba lesof arba o hammaavir arba ammot chayyav hu mittechillat haalachson shel arba ammot ad sofo veim heevir pachot mizze patur: 
Nimtza kan shalosh middot. ketzad. haoker chefetz mershut harabbim mimmakom ze vehinnicho bemakom acher birshut harabbim im haya ben shene hammekomot ad arba ammot hare ze muttar. haya benehen yeter mearba ammot vaadayin hen betoch chamesh ammot ushelosha chumshe amma patur. haya benehen chamesh ammot ushelosha chumshe amma beshave hare ze chayyav shehare heevir hachefetz chutz laalachsono shel merubba:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 13:
En hammotzi mershut lirshut o hammaavir birshut harabbim chutz learba ammot chayyav ad sheyyaakor chefetz meal gabbe makom sheyyesh bo arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yater veyanniach al gabbe makom sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa tefachim: 
Yado shel adam chashuva lo kearbaa al arbaa. lefichach im akar hachefetz miyyad adam haomed birshut zo vehinnicho beyad adam acher haomed birshut sheniyya chayyav. vechen im haya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ellu ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya veakar hachefetz mimmenna o miyyad adam haomed bah vehechezir yado elav chayyav. veaf al pi shello hinniach hachefetz bemakom shehu omed bo hoil vehu beyado hare hu kemunnach baaretz: 
Haya ochel veyotze mershut lirshut vechishshev lehotzi haochel shebbefiv mershut lirshut chayyav. mippene shemmachashavto mesima piv mekom arbaa af al pi shello hotzi kederech hammotziin. vechen mi shehaya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ellu vehishtin mayim o rakak birshut sheniyya chayyav shehare akar mershut zo vehinniach birshut sheniyya umachashavto osa oto keillu akar meal gabbe mekom arbaa. haya omed birshut zo ufi amma birshut sheniyya vehishtin bah patur: 
Haya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya venatal mishsham mayim meal gabbe guma melea mayim vehotzian chayyav. shehammayim kullan keillu hen munnachin al haaretz. aval im haya keli tzaf al gabbe mayim uferot betoch hakkeli ufashat yado velakach min happerot vehotzi patur. shehare lo nachu happerot al gabbe haaretz venimtza shello akar meal gabbe mekom arbaa. veen tzarich lomar im hayu happerot tzafin al pene hammayim vehotziam shehu patur. vechen im haya shemen tzaf al pene hammayim vekalat min hashshemen vehotzio patur: 
Kevar amarnu sheen hammotzi mershut lirshut chayyav ad sheyyaakor veyanniach. aval im akar velo hinniach o hinniach velo akar patur. lefichach mi shehaya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ufashat yado lirshut sheniyya vechefetz beyado unetalo acher mimmennu o shennatan acher leyado chefetz vehechezir yado elav shenehem peturim shezze akar veze hinniach: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayta yado lemala mishshelosha. aval hayta yado betoch shelosha samuch laaretz hare ze kemi shehinniach baaretz vechayyav: 
Haya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ellu ufashat chavero yad mershut sheniyya venatal chefetz miyyad ze haomed birshut zo vehichniso etzlo o shehotzi chefetz meetzlo vehinniach beyad ze haomed. ze haomed lo asa kelum shehare chavero natan beyado o natal miyyado vachavero chayyav shehare akar vehinniach: 
Haya omed beachat mishshete reshuyot ellu venatan chavero chefetz beyado o al gabbav veyatza beoto hachefetz lirshut sheniyya veamad sham chayyav. mippene sheakirat gufo bachefetz shealav kaakirat chefetz meotah reshut vaamidato beoto hachefetz kehannachat hachefetz bakkarka sheamad bah. lefichach im yatza bachefetz shebbeyado o al gabbav velo amad birshut sheniyya ella chazar venichnas vehu beyado afillu yatza venichnas kol hayyom kullo ad sheyyatza hayyom patur. lefi sheakar velo hinniach. vaafillu amad letakken hammassooy shealav adayin hu patur ad sheyyaamod lanuach: 
Vechen mi shehayta chavilato al ketefo veratz bah afillu kol hayyom eno chayyav ad sheyyaamod. vehu sheyyihye ratz bah. aval im halach meat meat hare ze keoker umanniach veasur. lefichach mi shekkadash alav hayyom vachavilato al ketefo ratz bah ad sheyyaggia leveto vezorkah sham kilachar yad: 
Akar hachefetz mershut harabbim vehalach bo pachot mearba ammot veamad vechazar vehalach pachot mearba ammot veamad afillu kol hayyom kullo patur. bamme devarim amurim besheamad lanuach. aval im amad letakken massao hare ze kimhallech uchesheyyaamod chutz learba ammot chayyav. vehu sheyyaamod chutz learba ammot lanuach. aval im yaamod letakken massao adayin hu kimhallech veeno chayyav ad sheyyaamod lanuach chutz learba ammot: 
Haya kane o romach vechayyotze bo munnach al haaretz vehigbiah hakkatze haechad vehaya hakkatze hashsheni munnach baaretz vehishlicho lefanav vechazar vehigbiah hakkatze hashsheni shehaya munnach baaretz vehishlicho lefanav al derech zo ad sheheevir hachefetz kamma milin patur. lefi shello akar hachefetz kullo meal gabbe haaretz. veim mashach hachefetz ugeraro al haaretz mittechillat arba lesof arba chayyav shehamegalgel oker hu: 
Akar hachefetz mizzavit zo lehannicho bezavit acheret shennimtzet zo haakira akira hammutteret venimlach badderech vehotzio lirshut sheniyya patur. mippene shello hayta akira rishona lechach venimtzet kan hannacha belo akira. vechen haoker chefetz vehinnicho al chavero keshehu mehallech uveet sheyyirtze chavero laamod netalo meal gabbe chavero hare ze patur shehare yesh kan akira belo hannacha: 
Hazzorek chefetz mershut lirshut o mittechillat arba lesof arba birshut harabbim vekodem sheyyanuach kelato acher beyado o kelato kelev o nisraf patur. mippene sheen zo hannacha shennitkavven lah. lefichach im nitkavven bishat zerika lechach chayyav: 
Hazzorek chefetz mershut lirshut vehaya kashur bechevel vaagado beyado. im yachol limshoch hachefetz etzlo patur. shehare en kan hanacha gemura venimtza kemi sheakar velo hinniach: 
Hazzorek venacha betoch yado shel chavero. im amad chavero bimkomo vekibbelah hazzorek chayyav shehare akar vehinniach. veim neekar chavero mimmekomo vekibbelah patur. zarak veratz hazzorek atzmo achar hachefetz vekibbelo beyado birshut acheret o chutz learba ammot patur keillu neekar acher vekibbelo. sheen hahannacha gemura ad sheyyanuach hachefetz bemakom shehaya lo lanuach bo bishat akira: 
Hazzorek mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza af al pi sheavar hachefetz baavir reshut harabbim patur. vehu sheyyaavor lemala mishshelosha tefachim aval im avar befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz venach al gabbe mashshehu af al pi shenneekar o nitgalgel veyatza hachefetz mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid acheret hare hu kemi shennishar omed birshut harabbim ulefichach chayyav. vechen hazzorek mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim ureshut hayyachid baemtza patur. veim avar hachefetz befachot mishshelosha samuch laaretz venach al gabbe mashshehu af al pi shechazar venitgalgel veyatza lirshut harabbim hashsheniyya hare hu kemi shennishar omed birshut hayyachid ulefichach chayyav: 
Hammaavir arba ammot birshut harabbim zo im reshut harabbim hashsheniyya chayyav mippene shearba ammot bishte reshuyot harabbim mitztarfim mippene shello nach hachefetz barshut shebbenehen: 
Hammoshit mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim baemtza chayyav. vaafillu hoshit lemala meavir reshut harabbim. shekken hayta avodat haleviyyim bammishkan moshitin et hakkerashim meagala laagala ureshut harabbim ben shete haagalot vechol agala vaagala reshut hayyachid hi: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehayu shete reshut hayyachid beorech reshut harabbim kemo shehaagalot mehallechot birshut harabbim zo achar zo. aval im hayu shete harshuyyot bishne tzidde reshut harabbim af hammoshit mershut hayyachid zo lirshut hayyachid shekkenegdah patur: 
Shachach ufashat yado vehi melea perot vehotziah mechatzer zo lehachenisah lechatzer shebbetziddah venizkar kodem sheyyachnis vahare yado teluya baavir reshut harabbim muttar lehachazirah elav lachatzero. aval lehachenisah leotah hechatzer hashsheniyya asur. kede shello yaase machashavto shechashav bishat shegaga. veim hotzi yado bemezid hare ze asur lehachazirah etzlo ella kansu oto shettehe yado teluya ad shettechshach: 
Hammitkavven lizrok shemone ammot birshut harabbim venach hachefetz besof arba chayyav shehare naasa keshiur hammelacha venaaset machashavto. shehaddavar yadua sheen ze hachefetz maggia lesof shemone ad sheyyaavor al kol makom umakom mikkol hashshemone. aval im nitkavven lizrok arba venach hachefetz besof shemone patur. lefi shennach bemakom shello chashav shettaavor bo vechol shekken shettanuach. lefichach im chashav beet zerika sheyyanuach hachefetz bechol makom sheyyirtze chayyav: 
Zarak letoch arba ammot venitgalgel chutz learba ammot patur. zarak chutz learba ammot venitgalgel letoch arba ammot im nach al gabbe mashshehu chutz learba ammot veachar kach nitgalgel venichnas letoch arba ammot chayyav veim lo nach kelal hare ze patur:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 14:
Arva reshuyot leshabbat. reshut hayyachid ureshut harabbim vecharmelit umekom petor. e zo hi reshut harabbim midbarot vaayarot ushevakim uderachim hamefullashin lahen. uvilvad sheyyihye rochav hadderech shesh esre amma velo yihye alav tikra. vee zo reshut hayyachid tel sheggavoah asara tefachim verachav arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim o yeter al ken. vechen charitz shehu amok asara verachav arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken. vechen makom shehu mukkaf arba mechitztzot gavhan asara uvenehen arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken afillu yesh bo kamma milin im hukkaf ledira kegon medina hammukkefet choma sheddaltoteha ninalot ballayla umevoot sheyyesh lahen shelosha ketalim velechi beruach reviit. vechen chatzer vedir vesahar shehukkefu ledira kullan reshut hayyachid gemura hen: 
Afillu kelim kegon sefina o migdal shel etz vechavveret vechayyotze bahen im yesh bahen arbaa al arbaa begova asara o yeter al ze hare hen reshut hayyachid gemura: 
Ovi hakketalim shel reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid. laacherim ose mechitztza leatzmo lo kol shekken. avir reshut hayyachid kirshut hayyachid ad larakia. aval avir reshut harabbim eno kirshut harabbim ella ad asara tefachim. ulemala measara baavir reshut harabbim mekom petor hu: 
E zo hi karmelit tel sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken vegavho mishshelosha vead asara. shehakkarmelit enah tofeset ella ad asara veenah rechava pachot mearbaa al arbaa. vechen charitz sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken veamok mishshelosha ad asara. vechen makom shehukkaf bearba mechitztzot gavhan mishshelosha vead asara uvenehen arbaa al arbaa o yeter al ken. vechen keren zavit hassemucha lirshut harabbim vehu hammakom shemmukkaf shalosh mechitztzot veharuach harviit reshut harabbim kegon mavoy sheen lo lechi o kora beruach reviit vechen hayyammim vehabbika ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim kol ellu karmelit hen: 
Avir hakkarmelit hare hu kecharmelit ad asara tefachim. ulemala measara tefachim baavir hakkarmelit hare hu mekom petor. lefichach meal pene hammayim shebbayyammim veshebbanneharot ad asara tefachim kaavir karmelit. ulemala measara mekom petor. aval kol haomek hammelea mayim hare hu kekarka ava: 
Bor shebbecharmelit hare hu kecharmelit afillu amok mea amma im en bo arbaa. reshut harabbim shehayta aleha tikra o sheen berachbah 16 amma hare hi kecharmelit. itztabba shebben haammudim haomdim birshut harabbim hare hi kecharmelit. vetzidde reshut harabbim kecharmelit. aval ben haammudim hoil verabbim dorsin benehen hare hen reshut harabbim: 
E zehu mekom petor. makom sheyyesh bo pachot mearbaa al arbaa vegavho shelosha ad larakia shekkol pachot mishshelosha hare hu kaaretz. afillu kotzim uvarkanim o gelalim birshut harabbim gavhan shelosha veen rachban arbaa al arbaa hare hen mekom petor. vechen charitz sheen bo arbaa al arbaa veamko mishshelosha ad hattehom. vechen makom hammukkaf sheen bo arbaa al arbaa afillu haya arko elef mil verachbo arbaa pachot seora vegavho mishshelosha ulemala hare ze mekom petor. vechen avir reshut harabbim o avir karmelit lemala measara hare hu mekom petor: 
Makom sheyyesh begavho tisha tefachim metzumtzamim lo pachot velo yeter birshut harabbim hare hu kirshut harabbim. veen mashgichin al middat arko umiddat rachbo ben rachav ben katzar mippene sherabbim mechattefin alav. aval im haya yeter al tisha o pachot im haya bo arbaa al arbaa o yeter hare hu karmelit. veim en bo arbaa al arbaa hare hu mekom petor: 
Gag hassamuch lirshut harabbim betoch asara tefachim hoil verabbim mechattefin alav asur letaltel baggag ad sheyyaase lo sullam kavua lehattiro. ammud birshut harabbim gavoah asara verachav arbaa hare ze reshut hayyachid. naatz begavho yated kol shehu afillu enah gevoha shelosha hoil verauy litlot bayyated ulehishtammesh bo hare ze memaato venaasa karmelit. veen moddin lo ella min hayyated ulemala. vaafillu milleahu kullo yetedot hare ze memaet gavho. shehare tolin beotan hayetedot umishtammeshim bahen: 
Chore reshut hayyachid hare hen kirshut hayyachid. aval chore reshut harabbim enam kirshut harabbim ella hare hen kefi middatan. ketzad. chor betzad reshut harabbim im yesh bo arbaa al arbaa vegavoah asara hare hu reshut hayyachid. veim en gavoah asara hare ze karmelit. veim en bo arbaa al arbaa hare ze mekom petor. vehu sheggavoah shelosha. shekkol happachut mishshelosha hare hu kaaretz: 
Reshut hayyachid umekom petor muttar letaltel bechullan afillu haya orech kol achat mishshetehen kamma milin metaltel bechullah. aval reshut harabbim vehakkarmelit en metaltelin bahen ella bearba ammot. veim heevir o hoshit o zarak chutz learba ammot birshut harabbim chayyav uvecharmelit patur. sheissur hakkarmelit middivrehem mippene shehi doma lirshut harabbim shemma titchallef birshut harabbim. lefichach im lo haya tzarich leguf hahotzaa kegon sheheevir kotz becharmelit kede shello yizzoku bo rabbim hare ze muttar. vaafillu heeviro kamma ammot. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Keshem shemmuttar letaltel bechol mekom petor kach muttar lehachenis mimmennu lirshut hayyachid o lirshut harabbim veen tzarich lomar lecharmelit. umotziin lo mershut hayyachid umershut harabbim veen tzarich lomar min hakkarmelit: 
Keshem sheasur letaltel bechol hakkarmelit kach asur lehotzi mimmenna lirshut hayyachid o lirshut harabbim o lehachenis lecharmelit mershut hayyachid o mershut harabbim. veim hotzi o hichnis patur: 
Hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid o mershut harabbim lirshut harabbim vecharmelit baemtza patur. vechen hammoshit o hazzorek mizzo lezo vecharmelit baemtza patur. hammotzi chefetz mershut harabbim lecharmelit vehinnicho sham vechazar vaakaro mikkarmelit vehichniso lirshut hayyachid. o shehotzio mershut hayyachid lecharmelit vehinnicho sham vechazar vaakaro mikkarmelit vehotzio lirshut harabbim hare ze patur: 
Hammotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim veavar al mekom petor shehaya benehen bahalichato chayyav. shemmehallech eno keomed. veen tzarich lomar bezorek sheavar hachefetz bimkom petor sheeno chashuv kemi shennach sham. haya omed bimkom petor venatal chefetz mershut hayyachid o meadam haomed sham vehinnicho birshut harabbim o beyad adam haomed sham patur. vechen im hichnis mershut harabbim lirshut hayyachid veamad bimkom petor, patur: 
Ammud birshut harabbim gavoah asara verachav arbaa veen beikkaro arbaa veyesh baggova hakkatzar shello shelosha hare hu reshut hayyachid veim zarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav. tel hammitlakket gove asara tefachim mittoch orech arba ammot hare hu reshut hayyachid veim zarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav: 
Naatz kane birshut hayyachid afillu gavoah mea amma vezarak mershut harabbim venach al gabbav chayyav. shershut hayyachid ola ad larakia. ilan shehu omed birshut hayyachid venofo note lirshut harabbim vezarak venach al nofo patur. sheen hannof holech achar haikkar: 
Naatz kane birshut harabbim uverosho teraskal vezarak venach al gabbav patur sheen reshut harabbim ella ad asara. hazzorek arba ammot birshut harabbim venach hachefetz bakkotel. kegon shezzarak chelev o batzek venidbak bakkotel. im nidbak lemala measara tefachim kezorek baavir. shellemala measara birshut harabbim mekom petor hu. nidbak lematta measara tefachim kezorek baaretz vechayyav. zarak lemala measara venach bechor kol shehu patur: 
Zarak kane o romach mershut hayyachid venitka birshut harabbim keshehu omed patur. shehare miktzato bimkom petor. zarak keli mershut hayyachid lirshut harabbim vehaya oto keli gadol veyesh bo arbaa al arbaa begova asara patur. mippene shekkeli ze reshut hayyachid gemura venimtza kemotzi mershut hayyachid lirshut hayyachid: 
Bor tisha birshut harabbim veakar chulya mikkarkaito vehishlimo laasara. af al pi sheakirat hachefetz vaasiyyat hammechitztza bain keachat patur. mippene shello hayta hammechitztza asara battechilla. haya habbor asara vehishlich bo chulya umiato measara patur. shehare hannachat hachefetz vesilluk hammechitztza bain keachat: 
Hazzorek daf venach al gabbe yetedot birshut harabbim venaasa reshut hayyachid afillu haya keli al gabbe haddaf patur. shehare asiyyat hammechitztza im nuchat hakkeli bain keachat: 
Bor shehu amok asara verachav shemona birshut harabbim vezarak machtzelet mershut harabbim vechilleka habbor berachbo lishnayim patur. shehare im hannachat hakkeli batlu hammechitztzot venaasa kol makom mehen pachot mearbaa al arbaa: 
Bor birshut harabbim amok asara verachav arbaa male mayim vezarak letocho chefetz venach al gabbe hammayim chayyav. sheen hammayim mevattelin hammechitztzot. haya male perot vezarak letocho patur. shehare miatu happerot et shiuro: 
Rekak mayim shehu over birshut harabbim verabbim mehallechin bo. im en beamko asara tefachim hare hu kirshut harabbim. ben shehaya rachav afillu arba ammot ben shello haya berachbo arbaa tefachim. shehare rov haam medallegin alav veen mehallechin betocho. hoil veen beamko asara hare hu reshut harabbim. veim yesh beamko asara o yeter hare hu kecharmelit kishar hayyamim. vehu sheyyesh berachbo arbaa tefachim o yeter al ken. sheen karmelit pechuta mearbaa:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 15:
Omed adam birshut harabbim umetaltel birshut hayyachid kullah. veomed birshut hayyachid umittaltel birshut harabbim uvilvad shello yotzi chutz learbaa ammot. veim hotzi patur mippene shehu birshut acheret. vechen omed adam birshut hayyachid ufoteach birshut harabbim, birshut harabbim ufoteach birshut hayyachid. behema shehayta rubbah bachutz veroshah bifnim ovsin otah. uvegamal ad sheyyehe rosho verubbo bifnim hoil vetzavvaro aroch: 
Lo yaamod adam birshut hayyachid veyishte birshut harabbim. birshut harabbim veyishte birshut hayyachid. ella im ken hichnis rosho verubbo lemakom shehu shote. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya shote bechelim naim shehu tzarich lahen. gezera shemma yotziem. aval im hayu kelim sheenan naim sheeno tzarich lahen. o shehaya habbor becharmelit af al pi shehakkelim naim. machnis rosho bilvad veshote bimkomo veaf al pi shello hichnis rosho verubbo: 
Omed adam birshut harabbim vekolet min haavir min hammayim hamekallechin min hatztzinnor o min hakkotel veshote. uvilvad shello yigga batztzinnor o bakkotel veyiklot meal gabban. veim naga im haya makom shennaga bo lemala measara befachot mishshelosha samuch laggag hare ze asur. shennimtza keoker meal haggag shehu reshut hayyachid. vechen im haya batztzinnor arbaa al arbaa ben shehaya hatztzinnor betoch asara ben shehaya lemala measara vekalat mimmennu mayim hare ze asur. velamma eno chayyav mippene shello nachu hammayim ella hare hen nizchalin veholchin: 
Ziz shellifne hachallon yotze baavir sheal reshut harabbim. im haya lemala measara tefachim muttar lehishtammesh alav sheen reshut harabbim tofeset ella asara tefachim. lefichach muttar lehishtammesh bechol hakkotel ad asara tefachim hattachtonim: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya ziz echad yotze baavir. aval im hayu yotzim bakkotel shene zizin ze lematta mizze af al pi sheshshenehem lemala measara. im yesh bazziz haelyon shellifne hachallon rochav arbaa al arbaa asur lehishtammesh alav. mippene shehu reshut bifne atzmo vehazziz shettachtav reshut acheret. veasru ze al ze. sheen shete reshuyot mishtammeshot birshut achat: 
En baelyon arbaa veen battachton arbaa. mishtammesh bishnehen vechen bechol hakkotel ad asara tefachim hattachtonim. haya battachton arbaa vehaelyon en bo arbaa eno mishtammesh baelyon ella keneged challono bilvad. aval bishar hazziz shebbishne tzidde hachallon asur lehishtammesh mippene ze shettachtav shechalak reshut leatzmo: 
Kol ziz hayyotze al avir reshut harabbim shemmuttar lehishtammesh alav. keshehu mishtammesh bo en notnin alav veen notlin mimmennu ella kele cheres uzechuchit vechayyotze bahen sheim yippelu lirshut harabbim yishshavru. aval shear kelim voochalin asurim shemma yippelu lirshut harabbim viviem: 
Shene battim bishne tzidde reshut harabbim zarak mizzo lazo lemala measara patur vehu sheyyihyu shenehem shello o sheyyihye benehem eruv. vaafillu begadim uchele mattachot muttar lizrok. veim haya ze lemala mizze velo haya beshave asur lizrok beged vechayyotze bo shemma yippol viviennu. aval kele cheres vechayyotze bahen zorek: 
Bor birshut harabbim vechallon al gabbav habbor vechulyato mitztarfim laasara umemallein mimmennu beshabbat. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya samuch lakkotel betoch arbaa tefachim sheen adam yachol laavor sham. aval im haya muflag en memallein mimmennu ella im ken hayta chulyato gevoha asara shennimtza haddeli kesheyyetze min hachulya yetze limkom petor: 
Ashpa birshut harabbim gevoha asara tefachim vechallon al gabbah shofchin lah mayim beshabbat. bamme devarim amurim beashpa shel rabbim sheen darkah lehippanot. aval shel yachid en shofchin aleha shemma titpanne venimtzeu shofchin kedarkan birshut harabbim: 
Ammat hammayim shehi overet bechatzer im yesh begavhah asara tefachim uverachbah arbaa o yoter al ken ad eser ammot en memallein mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asu lah mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim bakkenisa uvaytzia. veim en begavhah asara o sheen berachbah arbaa memallein mimmenna belo mechitztza: 
Haya berachbah yeter meeser ammot af al pi sheen begavhah asara en memallein mimmenna ad sheyyaase lah mechitztza. shekkol yeter al eser pirtza hi umafsedet hammechitztzot. umahu letaltel bechol hechatzer. im nishar mitztzad happirtza pas mikkan ufas mikkan bechol shehu o pas rochav arbaa tefachim meruach achat muttar letaltel bechol hechatzer veen asur ella lemalleot min haamma bilvad. aval im lo nishar pas kelal asur letaltel bechol hechatzer shehare nifretza chatzer layyam shehu karmelit: 
Veheach maamidin et hammechitztza bemayim. im hayta lemala min hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach min hammechitztza yored betoch hammayim. veim hayta hammechitztza kullah yoredet betoch hammayim tzarich sheyyihye tefach mimmenna yotze lemala min hammayim. kede sheyyihyu hammayim shebbechatzer muvdalin af al pi sheen hammechitztza maggaat ad hakkarka hoil veyesh bah asara tefachim hare zo mutteret. velo hittiru mechitztza teluya ella bemayim bilvad. sheissur tiltul bemayim middivrehem vehekelu bimchitztza sheenah ella kede laasot hekker: 
Ammat hammayim haoveret ben hachatzerot vechallonot petuchot eleha. im en bah kashshiur meshalshelin deli min hachallonot umemalleim mimmenna beshabbat. bamme devarim amurim besheenah mufleget min hakkotel shelosha tefachim. aval im hayta mufleget min hakkotel shelosha tefachim en memalleim mimmenna ella im ken hayu passin yotzin min hakketalim mikkan umikkan shennimtza haamma keillu hi overet betoch hechatzer: 
Ketzotzra shehi lemala min hayyam vechallon betochah al gabbe hammayim. en memalleim mimmenna beshabbat ella im ken asu mechitztza gevoha asara tefachim al gabbe hammayim keneged hachallon shebbakketzotzra. o tihye hammechitztza yoredet min hakketzotzra keneged hammayim veroin otah keillu yarda venaga ad hammayim. ucheshem shemmemallein mizzo sheasu lah mechitztza kach shofchin mimmenna al hayyam. shehare al hakkarmelit hen shofchin: 
Chatzer shehi pechuta mearba ammot al arba ammot en shofchin betochah mayim beshabbat mippene shehen yotzin lirshut harabbim bimhera. lefichach tzarich laasot guma machzeket satayim betoch hechatzer o birshut harabbim betzad hechatzer kede sheyyihyu hammayim nikbatzim betochah. vetzarich livnot aleha kippa mibbachutz kede shello terae hauka hazzot birshut harabbim. vehechatzer vehaachsadra mitztarfin learba ammot. vechamma hu hammakom shemmachazik satayim chatzi amma al chatzi amma berum shelosha chumshe amma: 
Hayta hauka pechuta missatayim shofchin lah bemilluah. hayta machzeket satayim shofchin lah afillu shishshim sea shel mayim. veaf al pi shehammayim yitgabberu veyafutzu meal hagguma lachutz. bamme devarim amurim bimot haggeshamim shehachatzerot mitkalkelot usetam tzinnorot mekallechin velo yavou haroim lomar shezze mishtammesh birshut harabbim vehammayim yotzim mikkocho birshut harabbim. aval bimot hachamma im hayta machzeket satayim en shofchin lah ella satayim. hayta pechuta missatayim en shofchin lah kol ikkar: 
Biv sheshshofchin lo mayim vehen nizchalin veholchin tachat hakkarka veyotzin lirshut harabbim. vechen tzinnor sheshshofchin al piv mayim vehen nizchalin al hakkotel veyordin lirshut harabbim. afillu haya orech hakkotel o orech hadderech shettachat haaretz mea amma asur lishpoch al pi habbiv o al pi hatztzinnor mippene shehammayim yotzin mikkocho lirshut harabbim. ella shofech chutz labbiv vehen yordin labbiv: 
Bamme devarim amurim bimot hachamma aval bimot haggeshamim shofech veshone veeno nimna. shessetam tzinnorot mekallechin hen veadam rotze sheyyibbalu hammayim bimkoman. haya shofech al pi habbiv vehammayim yotzin lecharmelit hare ze muttar vaafillu bimot hachamma shello gazru al kocho becharmelit. lefichach muttar lishpoch al katle hassefina vehem yordin layyam: 
Lo yemalle adam mayim min hayyam vehu betoch hassefina ella im ken asa mekom arbaa al arbaa yotze min hassefina al hayyam. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya toch asara aval im haya lemala measara min hayyam motzi ziz kol shehu umemalle. shehare derech mekom petor memalle veeno tzarich leziz ze ella mishshum hekker: 
Hakkore besefer becharmelit venitgalgel miktzat hassefer lirshut harabbim umiktzato beyado. im nitgalgel lechutz learba ammot hofcho al hakketav umannicho. gezera shemma yishshamet kullo miyyado veyaavirennu arba ammot. nitgalgel letoch arba ammot gollo etzlo. vechen im nitgalgel lirshut hayyachid gollo etzlo. haya kore birshut hayyachid venitgalgel lirshut harabbim im nach bah hofcho al hakketav. veim lo nach ella haya taluy baavir reshut harabbim velo higgia laaretz gollo etzlo: 
Hammaavir kotz kede shello yizzoku bo rabbim. im haya birshut harabbim molicho pachot pachot mearba ammot. veim haya becharmelit molicho kedarko afillu mea amma. vechen met shehisriach venitbazza yeter midday velo yachlu shechenim laamod motziin oto mershut hayyachid lecharmelit. hayyored lirchotz bayyam keshehu ole menaggev atzmo shemma yaavir mayim shealav arba ammot becharmelit:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 16: Makom shello hukkaf ledoyra ella sheyyihye tashmisho laavir kegon gannot ufardesim uchegon hammakkif makom min haaretz leshamro vechayyotze bahen. im yesh begova hammechitztzot asara tefachim o yeter hare hu kirshut hayyachid lechayyev hammotzi vehazzorek vehammoshit mimmennu lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho. veen metaltelin bechullo ella im ken yesh bo bet satayim o pachot. aval im haya bo yeter al bet satayim asur letaltel bo ella bearba ammot kecharmelit:

Vechen ammud sheggavoah asara tefachim verachav ad bet satayim metaltelin al kullo. haya rachav al bet satayim en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot. sela shebbayyam haya gavoah pachot measara metaltelin mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho shehakkol karmelit. haya gavoah asara im haya rachbo mearbaa tefachim ad bet satayim hoil umuttar letaltel bechullo en metaltelin lo mittocho layyam velo min hayyam letocho. haya yeter mibbet satayim af al pi shehu reshut hayyachid hoil veasur letaltel bo ella bearba ammot kecharmelit hare ze muttar letaltel mittocho layyam umin hayyam letocho shezze davar sheeno matzuy hu velo gazru bo:

Kamma hi bet sea chamishshim amma al chamishshim amma. nimtza bet satayim makom sheyyesh betishbarto chameshet alafim amma. vechol makom sheyyesh bo kammidda hazzot ben shehaya merubba shehu shivim amma veshirayim al shivim amma veshirayim ben shehaya agol ben shear hatztzurot hare ze nikra bet satayim:

Makom shello hukkaf ledira sheyyesh bo bet satayim im haya arko pi shenayim kerachbo kede sheyyihye mea al chamishshim kachatzar hammishkan muttar letaltel bechullo. aval im haya arko yeter al shenayim kerachbo afillu amma en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot. shello asu bet satayim shettashmisho laavir kishar hachatzerot ella mechatzar hammishkan:

Makom shehukkaf shello leshem dira im paratz bo pirtza yeter al eser ammot begova asara tefachim vegadar bah leshem dira ad asara muttar letaltel bechullah. vaafillu paratz amma ugedarah leshem dira ufaratz amma ugedarah leshem dira ad shehishlimah leyeter meeser muttar letaltel bechullah af al pi sheyyesh bo kamma milin:

Makom yater mibbet satayim shehukkaf ledira im nizra rubbo hare hu keginna veasur letaltel bechullo. nizra miuto im nizra mimmennu bet satayim muttar letaltel bechullo. veim haya hammakom hazzarua yeter mibbet satayim asur letaltel bechullo. nata rubbo hare hu kechatzer umuttar letaltel bechullo. nitmalle mayim afillu hayu amukkim harebe im hayu reuyin letashmish hare hen kintaim umuttar letaltel bechullo. veim enan reuyin letashmish en metaltelin bo ella bearba ammot:

Makom shehukkaf shello leshem dira sheyyesh bo bet shalosh sein vekeru bo bet sea keruyo mattiro sheppi tikra yored vesotem. nifratz bimloo lechatzer venifretza chatzer kenegdo. chatzer mutteret keshehayta vehakkarpaf asur keshehaya. sheen avir hechatzer mattiro:

Haya yeter mibbet satayim uva lemaato bailanot eno miut. bana bo ammud betzad hakkotel gavoah asara verachav shelosha o yeter hare ze miut. pachot mishshelosha eno miut shekkol pachot mishshelosha kelavud dami. vechen im hirchik min hakkotel shelosha veasa mechitztza hare ze miut. pachot mishshelosha lo asa kelum:

Tach et hakkotel betit af al pi sheeno yachol laamod bifne atzmo hare ze miut. hirchik min hattel shelosha veasa mechitztza hoil. asa mechitztza al sefat hattel eno moil shehaose mechitztza al gabbe mechitztza eno moil. nivlea mechitztza hattachtona vahare haelyona kayyemet. hoil venaaset haelyona leshem dira vahare en sham nire ella hi hare ze hoil umuttar letaltel bechullah:

Rechava sheachore battim yetera al bet satayim en metaltelin bah ella bearba. vaafillu haya petach habbayit patuach letochah. veim patach happetach lesham veachar kach hikkifa hare zo kemukkefet ledira umuttar letaltel bechullah:

Rechava happetucha lammedina mitztzad echad umitztzad acher petucha lashshevil hammaggia lannahar. ose lah lechi mitztzad hammedina veyihye muttar letaltel bechullah umittochah lammedina umin hammedina letochah:

Yachid sheshshavat bevika veasa mechitztza saviv lo im yesh bah ad bet satayim muttar letaltel bechullah. veim hayta yeter al bet satayim eno metaltel bah ella bearba ammot. vechen im hayu shenayim. aval shelosha yisreelim o yeter alehen sheshshavtu bevika hare hen shayyara umuttar lahem letaltel bechol tzarkan afillu kamma milin. vehu shello yishshaer min hammechitztza shehikkifu bet satayim panuy belo kelim. aval im nishar bet satayim panuy belo kelim velo hayu tzerichim lo asurim letaltel bechol hammechitztza ella bearba ammot. veen hakkatan mashlim leshayyara:

Shelosha shehikkifu kede tzarkan vekanu shevita veachar kach met echad mehen hare hem muttarin letaltel bechullah. kanu shenayim shevita beyeter mibbet satayim veachar kach ba lahem shelishi asurin letaltel ella bearba ammot keshehayu kodem sheyyavo ze. shehashshevita hi haggoremet lo haddiyyurin:

Shelosha mekomot hammukkafin shello leshem dira ze betzad ze ufetuchim ze laze shenayim hachitzonim rechavim vehaemtzai katzar shennimtzeu lashshenayim hachitzonim passin mikkan umikkan vehaya yachid baze veyachid baze veyachid baze naasu keshayyara venotnin lahem kol tzarkan. haya haemtzai rachav ushenayim hachitzonim ketzarim shennimtza haemtzai befassin mishshene ruchotav hare hu muvdal mishshenayim hachitzonim. lefichach im shavat yachid baze veyachid baze veyachid baze en notnin lahen kol tzarkan ella kol echad veechad yesh lo bet satayim bimkomo. haya yachid baze veyachid baze ushenayim baemtzai o shenayim baze ushenayim baze veechad baemtzai notnin lahen kol tzarkan:

Kol mechitztza sheenah yechola laamod beruach metzuya enah mechitztza. vechol mechitztza sheenah asuya lenachat enah mechitztza. vechol mechitztza sheenah asuya ella litzniut bilvad enah mechitztza. vechol mechitztza sheen begavhah asara tefachim o yoter enah mechitztza gemura. giddud chamishsha umechitztza chamishsha mitztarfin:

Kol mechitztza sheyyesh bah parutz merubbe al haomed enah mechitztza. aval im haya parutz keomed hare zo mutteret. uvilvad shello yihye beotan happeratzot pirtza shehi yeter al eser ammot. aval eser ammot hare hi kefetach. im haya lefirtza zo tzurat petach af al pi sheyyesh bah yoter meeser enah mafsedet hammechitztza. vehu shello yehe happarutz merubbe al haomed:

Bamme devarim amurim bizman shehapperatzot mishshelosha tefachim ulemala. aval im hayu happeratzot kol pirtza mehen pechuta mishshelosha hare zo mutteret. veaf al pi shehapparutz merubbe al haomed. shekkol pachot mishshelosha hare hu kelavud:

Ketzad. hare shehikkif bekanim veen ben kane lachavero shelosha tefachim. o shehikkif bachavalim veen ben chevel lachavero shelosha tefachim. hare zo mechitztza gemura. af al pi shehi sheti belo erev o erev belo sheti. vetzarich sheyyihye gova hakkane asara o sheyyihye min haaretz ad sof ovi hachevel haelyon asara im hikkif bachavalim. sheen mechitztza pechuta measara. vechol hashshiurin haellu halacha lemoshe missinay hen:

Tzurat petach haamura bechol makom hi afillu kane vechayyotze bo mikkan vekane mikkan vekane al gabbehen. gova shene hallechayayim asara tefachim o yeter vehakkane vechayyotze bo sheal gabbehen af al pi sheeno nogea bishne hallechayayim ella yesh benehen kamma ammot hoil vegova hallechayayim asara hare zo tzurat petach. vetzurat petach sheamru tzericha shettehe beria lekabbel delet afillu delet shel kash:

Patach shetztzurato kippa im yesh beorech ragle hakkippa asara tefachim hare ze tzurat petach. vetzurat petach sheasa otah min hatztzad enah kelum sheen derech happetachim lihyot bekeren zavit ella beemtza:
Bakkol osin mechitztza ben bechelim ben boochalim ben beadam afillu bivhema ushear mine chayya veof vehu sheyyihyu kefutim kede shello yanudu:

Mechitztza haomedet meeleha hare zo keshera. umechitztza hannaaset beshabbat hare zo mechitztza. veim naaset bishgaga muttar letaltel bah beotah shabbat. vehu shettease shello ledaat hammetaltel. aval im nitkavven adam lezo hammechitztza shettease beshabbat kede letaltel bah af al pi sheasa otah haose bishgaga asur letaltel bah beotah shabbat. vechen im naaset bemezid af al pi shello nitkavven ze letaltel bah hare ze asur letaltel bah:

Muttar laasot mechitztza shel bene adam beshabbat sheyyaamod ze betzad ze uvilvad shello yedu ellu haomdin shebbishvil laasotan mechitztza heemidan. velo yaamid otan adam shehu rotze lehishtammesh bimchitztza zo ella yaamid otan acher shello ledato:

Ilan shehu mesech al haaretz im en nofo gavoah min haaretz shelosha tefachim memalle ben badayo vealav teven vekash vechayyotze bahen vekoshran baaretz ad sheyyaamod beruach metzuya velo yitnadned umetaltel tachat kullo. vehu sheyyihyu tachtav ad bet satayim. aval im haya yeter mibbet satayim en metaltelin tachtav ella bearba ammot mippene shettachtav makom shello hukkaf ledira hu:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 17:
Mavoy sheyyesh lo shelosha ketalim hu hannikra mavoy satum. umavoy sheyyesh lo shene ketalim bilvad ze keneged ze vehaam nichnasin beruach zo veyotzin beshekkenegdah hu hannikra mavoy hamefullash: 
Heach mattirin mavoy hassatum. ose lo beruach reviit lechi echad o ose alav kora vedayyo. vetechashev otah kora o oto lechi keillu satam ruach reviit veyease reshut hayyachid veyihye muttar letaltel bechullo. sheddin tora beshalosh mechitztzot bilvad muttar letaltel umiddivre sofrim hi haruach harviit ulefichach day lah belechi o kora: 
Veheach mattirin mavoy mefullash. ose lo tzurat petach mikkan velechi o kora mikkan. umavoy akom torato kimfullash: 
Mavoy shehu shave mittocho umidron lirshut harabbim o shave lirshut harabbim umidron letocho eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora shehare hu muvdal mershut harabbim: 
Mavoy shetztziddo echad kale layyam vetziddo echad kale leashpa shel rabbim eno tzarich kelum. sheashpa shel rabbim enah asuya lehitpannot veen choshshin shemma yaale hayyam sirton: 
Mavoy mefullash shehu kale leemtza rechava shel rabbim. im lo haya mechuvvan keneged petach harchava hare ze kesatum veeno tzarich mitztzad harchava kelum. aval im haya kale letzidde harchava asur. veim hayta shel yachid af leemtzaah asur. peamim bone mitztzad echad venimtza kale letziddah shel rechava: 
En hammavoy nittar belechi o kora ad sheyyihyu battim vachatzerot petuchot letocho veyihye arko mearba ammot ulemala veyihye arko yater al rachbo. aval mavoy shearko kerachbo hare hu kechatzer veeno nittar ella bishne lechayayim mishshene ruchotav kol lechi bemashshehu. o befas rachav arbaa meruach achat: 
Chatzer shearkah yeter al rachbah hare hi kemavoy venitteret belechi o kora. umavoy sheen battim vachatzerot petuchot letocho kegon shello haya bo ella bayit echad o chatzer achat vechen mavoy sheen bearko arba ammot eno nittar ella bishne lechayayim o befas arbaa umashshehu: 
Mavoy sheen berachbo shelosha tefachim eno tzarich lo lechi velo kora umuttar letaltel bechullo. shekkol pachot mishshelosha hare hu kelavud. mavoy shehechshero bekora af al pi shemmuttar letaltel bechullo kirshut hayyachid hazzorek mittocho lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho patur. shehakkora mishshum hekker hi asuya. aval im hechshero belechi hazzorek mittocho lirshut harabbim o mershut harabbim letocho chayyav shehallechi hare hu kimchitztza beruach reviit: 
Shene ketalim birshut harabbim vehaam ovrim benehem ketzad machshir benehem. ose delatot mikkan udelatot mikkan veachar kach yaase benehem reshut hayyachid. veeno tzarich linol haddelatot ballayla aval tzarich sheyyihyu reuyot lehinnael. hayu meshukkaot beafar mefanne otan umetakkenan lehinnael. aval tzurat petach o lechi vekora enan moilin behechsher reshut harabbim: 
Muttar letaltel bemavoy tachat hakkora o ben hallechayayim. bamme devarim amurim beshehaya samuch lirshut harabbim. aval im haya samuch lecharmelit asur letaltel tachat hakkora o ben hallechayayim ad sheyyaase lechi acher lehattir toch happetach shehare matza min et mino veneor: 
Bakkol osin lechayayim afillu bedavar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim vaafillu beissure hanaya. avoda zara atzmah o ashera sheasa otah lechi kasher shehallechi avyo kol shehu. gova hallechi en pachot measara tefachim rachbo veavyo kol shehu: 
Bakkol osin kora aval lo baashera lefi sheyyesh lerochav hakkora shiur. vechol hashshiurin asurim min haashera. vechen rochav hakkora en pachot mittefach veavyah kol shehu. vehu shettihye beria lekabbel ariach shehu chatzi levena shel shelosha tefachim al shelosha tefachim. umaamide kora tzerichin sheyyihyu beriin kede lekabbel kora vachatzi levena: 
Kamma yihye petach hammavoy veyihye day lehacheshiro belechi o kora. gavho en pachot measara tefachim velo yeter al esrim amma verachbo ad eser ammot. bamme devarim amurim shello haya lo tzurat petach. aval im haya lo tzurat petach afillu haya gavoah mea amma o pachot measara o rochav mea amma hare ze muttar: 
Vechen im haya bekora shel mavoy kiyyur vetziyyur ad sheyyihyu hakkol mistakkelin bah af al pi shehi lemala meesrim amma keshera. shehakkora mishshum hekker asuya veim hayta lemala meesrim enah nikkeret veim yesh bah tziyyur vechiyyur mistakkelim bah venimtza sham hekker:
